Ka hun-a ne baseen ni

The first document by

Samwil

Samwil

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Nahuhud te seini ne baseen ka meyitenged te keet-etawan te nasud ne Israil te timpu ne si Samwil pad ka pangulu ran taman te nakasubal e si Saul ne migpangulu kandan. Ne si Saul ka an-anayan ne Hari. Nahuhud degma te seini ne baseen ke nekey ka egpuunan ne naawaan si Saul te katungdanan din isip Hari, wey impasubalan e sikandin te Manama ki Dabid.

This document tells concerning the people of nation of Israil at the time that Samwil was still their leader until Saul replaced (him) leading them. And Saul was the first king. This document also tells what is the reason that Saul was_removed_of his responsibility as king, and he was replaced with Dabid by God (MS Manama).

Te ware pad Hari dengan te Israil, iyan pad in-isip te me etew ne Hari dan ka Manama. Piru mighangyu sikandan te Manama ne egbehayan te Hari ne egpangulu kandan. Ne igkeupii te Manama ne egparuma-ruma ka Hari wey ka me etew te pegmandu din wey te kandin ne peggukum. Su ka langun ne katenged te etew, meyaman ma wey se egkaayu-ayu, keilangan ne egpekeuyun te Balaud te Manama.

Before there_was a king of Israil before, the people considered God as their king. But they requested God to_be_given a king to_lead them. And God desired that the king and the people went_along_with his reigning and his judging. Because all the authority of a person, rich or poor, it's_necessary to_correspond_with the Law of God.

Ka uluwan te seini ne baseen sika se pegkamatinumanen te Manama ne diye egpangkus te kapanaluwan, wey ka pegsupak te igkeupii te Manama ne diye egpangkus te karereetan. Naay-ayaran sika nalalag te Manama diye te kapitulu 2:30 ne miggenendue, “Ka migtahud keddi, egtahuren ku degma wey ka miglemet keddi, eglemetan ku degma.”

The theme of this document is the faithfulness of God that will_result in victory, and the disobedience of what_God_wants that will_result in destruction. God spoke that carefully in chapter 2:30 that goes, “The (one who) respects me, I will_ also _respect and the (one who) mocks me, I will_ also _mock.”

Si Ilkana wey ka pamilya rin diye te Silu

Ilkana and his family at Silu

11 Due sabeka ne etew ne matig-Rama[fn] ne diye te bubungan te Ipraim.[fn] Ka ngaran din si Ilkana—anak sikandin ni Hiruham ne anak ni Ilihu. Si Ilihu, anak ni Tuhu ne anak ni Sup ne sakup te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim. 2 Si Ilkana due daruwa ne asawa: si Hana wey si Pinina. Due me anak ni Pinina piru ware mule ki Hana.

11 There was a person from_Rama[fn] there in the mountain(s) of Ipraim.[fn] His name was Ilkana—he was the child of Hiruham the child of Ilihu. Ilihu, was the child of Tuhu the child of Sup under_the_jurisdiction_of the descendants of Ipraim. 2 Ilkana had two spouses: Hana and Pinina. Pinina had children but Hana on_the_contrary had_none.

3 Ne tagse leg-un, egtakereg ensi Ilkana diye te Silu eyew egsimba wey egpanubad te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye. Ne iyan talagpanubad te Magbebaye ne Manama ka daruwa ne anak ni Ili ne si Hupni wey Pinihas.

3 And each year, Ilkana and_company would go_uphill to Silu in_order to worship and sacrifice to Very Strong Lord. And the sacrificer(s) of the Lord God were Hupni and Pinihas the two children of Ili.

4 Te timpu ne egpanubad si Ilkana, egbaaran din ka asawa rin ne si Pinina wey ka me anak dan ne me malitan wey me lukes. 5 Piru egdakelen din mule ka ki Hana tenged su inggeyinawaan din sikandin minsan ware sikandin paanaka te Magbebaye. 6 Ne tenged su kene egpakaanak si Hana, layun de sikandin egdali-dii te duwey rin ne si Pinina. 7 Seini ka egkeyitabu te tagse leg-un: Egdali-dian ni Pinina si Hana tagse eggendiye sikandin te baley te Magbebaye. Sikan naa ka egpakasinehew naan de sikandin wey kene egkeen. 8 Ne mig-insaan sikandin ni Ilkana, “Hana, mania te egsinehew ka, kene egkeen, wey mania te eglungku ka? Kene e bes pad ne eleg keykew su eg-awes ke pad te sapulu ne anak ne lukes?”

4 At the time when Ilkana was sacrificing, he would apportion what_ he _sacrificed to his spouse Pinina and her females and males children. 5 But he would_increase the (portion) for Hana because he loved her even_though she hadn't been_caused_to_have_a_child by the Lord. 6 And because Hana could_ not _have_children, she was_ always _jeered_at by her junior_wife Pinina. 7 This was what_happened each year: Hana would_be_jeered_at by Pinina each (time) she went to the house of the Lord. That's why she just would_cry and didn't eat. 8 And she was_asked by Ilkana, “Hana, why are you(sg) weeping, not eating, and why are you(sg) grieving? Am I not [surprise] correct for you(sg) because you(sg) still desire ten male children?”

Si Hana wey si Ili

Hana and Ili

9 Te nekeimpus e sikandan ka egkeen wey eg-inum diye te Silu, migsasindeg si Hana wey mig-awe e dutu. Ne diyad e sikandin migsasindeg te marani te baley te Magbebaye. Ne si Ili ne talagpanubad, diye migpinnuu te marani te sungkaleg te gumawan. 10 Amana ne masakit ka pusung ni Hana, sikan naa ka mig-ampu sikandin te Magbebaye wey migpanaman-taman migpandalawit. 11 [xr]Ne migsaad sikandin ne migkahi, “He Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, pitawa nu ka peglungku ku te suluhuanen nu, wey tantanuri a nikeykew wey kena a kalingawi. Ke egbehayan a nikeykew te anak ne lukes, igbehey ku red sikandin keykew eyew egpamakey sikandin keykew te intiru ne umul rin, wey kene ku iya egpatempuhan ka bulbul rin.[fn]”

9 When they had_finished eating and drinking at Silu, Hana stood and left there. And she stood near the house of the Lord. And Ili the sacrificer, sat near to the post of the doorway. 10 Hana was very upset (LIT Hana's heart was very sore), that's why she prayed to the Lord and wept continually. 11 [xr]And she promised and said, “Oh Very Strong Lord, look(sg) at my grieving as your(sg) servant, watch(sg) me and don't forget me. If I'm given a male child by_you(sg), I will_ just _give him to you(sg) so_that he can serve you(sg) for his entire life, and I won't indeed cut his hair.[fn]”

12 Ne taheed te migpabulus sikandin ka mig-ampu te Magbebaye, intetengtengan ni Ili ka bibig din. 13 Indiralem de ni Hana te eg-ampu wey bibig din de ka egkaweil-weil wey kene egkarineg ka laheng din. Sikan naa ka migsuman-suman si Ili ne newubug sikandin. 14 Ne migkahiyan din sikandin, “Ken-u ke pad egpeeneng-eneng ka eg-inum? Kene kad e inum!”

12 And while she continued praying to the Lord, Ili watched her lip(s). 13 Hana just prayed inside (herself) and just her lips moved and her voice couldn't be heard. That's why Ili thought that she was drunk. 14 And he said to her, “When will_ you(sg) stop _drinking? Don't(sg) drink!”

15 Ne migtabak si Hana, “Ahalen, wara a newubug. Wara a mig-inum te binu wey ke inumen naa ne egpekewubug, ke kene, due ingkalaggew ku amana wey impalihawang ku re seeye diye te Magbebaye. 16 Kene ka suman-suman ne mareet a ne malitan. Mig-ampu a kayi tenged su amana ne masakit ka pusung ku wey miglungku a amana.”

15 And Hana replied, “Master, I'm not drunk. I haven't drunk wine or other alcoholic drink, but rather, there's (something) that_ I'm very _sad_about and I just let_ that _out to the Lord. 16 Don't(sg) think that your(sg) servant is a bad woman. I prayed here because I was very upset (LIT my heart was very sore) and I am_grieving greatly.”

17 Ne migtabak si Ili, “Ew! Na, hipanew kad ne malinawen wey egbehayan ka te Manama te Israil te imbuyu nu kandin.” 18 Ne migkahi si Hana, “Ahalen, salamat de te keupiya nu keddi.” Ne miggipanew e sikandin wey migkeen e, wey warad sikandin miglungku.

17 And Ili answered, “Oh! Now_then, go(sg) in peace and you(sg) will_be_given by the God of Israil what_ you(sg) _requested him.” 18 And Hana said, “Master, thanks for your(sg) goodness to_me.” And she went and ate, and no_longer grieved.

Ka peglesut ni Samwil wey peghalad kandin

The birth of Samwil and offering him

19 Te seup e ne aldew, migselem-selem mig-enew si Ilkana duma te pamilya rin ne migsimba te Magbebaye. Te nekeimpus e sikandan, nanguli e sikandan diye te baley ran diye te Rama. Ne migguliran ni Ilkana si Hana wey intabak te Magbebaye ka peg-ampu din. 20 Te pegginguma te eleg ne timpu, naberes e si Hana wey mig-anak te lukes ne bate. Ingngaranan din sikandin ki Samwil[fn] te migkahi, “Imbuyu ku sikandin te Magbebaye.”

19 On the next day, Ilkana along_with his family rose early and worshiped the Lord. When they finished, they returned_home to their house in Rama. And Ilkana slept_with Hana and she was remembered by God. 20 When the correct time arrived, Hana became_pregnant and gave_birth to a male child. She named him Samwil[fn] saying, “I requested him from the Lord.”

21 Te seup ne leg-un, migtakereg e man-e si Ilkana duma te intiru ne pamilya rin diye te Silu eyew te pegpanubad diye te Magbebaye te tagse leg-un, wey te pegtuman te saad din. 22 Piru ware migduma si Hana kandan. Migkahiyan din de ka iglukes din, “Eyra, wey ad eggendiye ke egkalutas e ka bate. Eg-uyanen ku sikandin diye te baley te Magbebaye eyew ighalad wey diyad e sikandin eg-ugpe taman te egpatey sikandin.” 23 Migtabak si Ilkana, “Uya, himuwa nu ka insuman-suman nu ne meupiya, ugpe ke pa iya kayi taman te egkalutas e ka bate. Ne egbulihan ka perem te Magbebaye te pegtuman te saad nu kandin.[fn]” Sikan naa ka migpalunggehaat de si Hana diye te baley wey intanggu rin ka bate taman te nalutas e.

21 The next year, Ilkanan with his entire family ascended again to Silu in_order for sacrificing there to Lord each year, and for obeying his promise. 22 But Hana didn't accompany him. She only said to her husband, “Dear, I'll go when the child is weaned. I'll take him to the house of the Lord to be dedicated and he will_live there until he will_die.” 23 Ilkana answered, “Yes, do(sg) what you(sg) think is good, just you(sg) stay here until the child is weaned. And may you(sg) be_helped by the Lord in fulfilling your(sg) promise to him.[fn]” That's why Hana remained_behind at the house and looked_after the child until (it) was weaned.

24 Te nalutas e ka bate, in-uyan e sikandin ni Hana wey ni Ilkana diye te baley te Magbebaye diye te Silu. Ne mig-uyan degma sikandan te turu ne baka ne tatelu ne leg-un se kabuyahi wey senge-saku ne harina, wey sabeka ne puntil ne laplap te mananap ne intahuan te binu. Ne bate pad iya si Samwil te seeye ne timpu. 25 Te nahilang dan e ka baka, in-uyan dan e ka bate diye ki Ili. 26 Ne migkahiyan ni Hana si Ili, “Ahalen, sikeddi seeye se malitan ne nakita nu dengan kayi ne mig-ampu te Magbebaye. Mengeyibet pad te pegkeetew nu. 27 Seini ne bate ka in-ampu ku te Magbebaye. Indineg din ka seeye ne peg-ampu ku. 28 Sikan naa ka igbehey ku red degma sikandin te Magbebaye eyew egpamakey sikandin te intiru ne umul rin.”

24 When the child was weaned, he was_taken by Hana and Ilkana to the house of the Lord there at Silu. And they also took a bull cow that was three years old and one_sack of flour, and one container which was animal skin filled with wine. And Samwil was still indeed a young_child at that time. 25 When they had killed the cow, they took the child to Ili. 26 Hana said to Ili, “Master, I am that woman that you(sg) saw long_ago here praying to the Lord. I swear by your(sg) birth. 27 This is the child that I prayed_for to the Lord. He has_heard that prayer of mine. 28 That's why I give him to the Lord in_order to serve him for his entire life.”

Ne insimba ran[fn] ka Magbebaye diye.

11 Ne mig-uli e si Ilkana wey si Hana diye te baley ran diye te Rama. Piru inggaat dan de mule si Samwil eyew egpamakey te Magbebaye isip talagbulig te talagpanubad ne si Ili.

11 And Ilkana and Hana returned_home to their house in Rama. But on_the_contrary they left_ Samwil _behind in_order to_serve the Lord as a helper of the sacrificer Ili.

Ka mareet ne me anak ni Ili

The bad/evil children of Ili

12 Ne maddeet ka me anak ni Ili ne me lukes ne si Hupni wey si Pinihas ne me talagpanubad. Ware dan ilaa ka katenged te Magbebaye 13 wey ka me balaud ke nekey ka egkakuwa te me talagpanubad diye te me etew. Su ke due egpanubad, egparani seeye se suluhuanen te talagpanubad ne eg-uyan te dakel ne tinidur, wey taheed te impakalkalaan pad ka igpanubad, 14 igtiyuk din seini diye te kuren. Ne ka langun ne egkaangey kayi, egkuen te talagpanubad. Iling kayi ka eggimuwen te me anak ni Ili diye te me matig-Israil ne eggendiye te Silu eyew egpanubad. 15 Sengekakuwa, te kene pad egtutungen ka kalambuan, egparani ka suluhuanen te talagpanubad diye te etew ne migpanubad wey egkahi, “Behayi nu te sapu ka talagpanubad eyew egtuuhen din su kene sikandin egdawat te ngalap ne impakalkalaan e, ke kene, ka meyilew pad.”

12 And the male children of Ili who were Hupni and Pinihas were bad/evil(pl). They do not recognize the right of the Lord 13 and the customs of what the sacrificers get from the people. Because if there_is someone who sacrifices, the servant of the sacrificer would approach and bring big fork, and while the sacrifice of whoever was still boiling, 14 he poked this in the cooking_pot. And all that could_be_got like this, was_taken by the sacrificer. The children of Ili did this to the sacrifices of the (ones) from_Israil who went to Silu. 15 Sometimes, before the fat was_burned, the servant of the sacrificers would approach to the person sacrificing and saying, “Just give(sg) the flesh to the sacrificer for him to roast because he doesn't accept meat that's boiled, but rather, the still raw (meat).”

16 Ke egkahi ka seeye se etew ne migpanubad, “Egtutungen te pad ka kalambuan ne egkaayun kad e ne eg-angey taman te igkeupii nu,” ne egtabak ka suluhuanen te talagpanubad, “Kene egkaayun. Keilangan ne igbehey nu kuntee seini keddi, su ke kene, eg-ahawen ku seini.” 17 Dakel amana ka sale ne neyimu te me anak ni Ili diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye su ware dan ma tahura ka pegpanubad.

16 If the person who sacrificed says, “Let us(incl) just burn the fat then you(sg) can take whatever you(sg) want,” then the servant of the sacrificer would answer, “That's not possible. You(sg) need to give this to me now, if not, I'll snatch it.” 17 It was a great sin that was done by the children of Ili there in front of the Lord because they didn't respect the sacrificing.

Diye si Samwil te Silu

Samwil there at Shiloh

18 Ne migpabulus ne migpamakey te Magbebaye si Samwil wey migsaluub sikandin te hinabel ne egngaranan te ipud. 19 Te tagse leg-un, eggimu ka iney rin te egpekeiling te deisek ne linayun ne malayat se belad, wey eg-uyanen din seini diye ki Samwil ke eggendiye sikandan se alunggun te Silu eyew te pegpanubad te tagse leg-un ne pegpanubad. 20 Ne impanalanginan ni Ili si Ilkana wey ka igbeyi rin te migkahi, “Egbehayan ka perem te Magbebaye te duma pad ne me bate pinaahi te igbeyi nu ne igliwan te sabeka ne bate ne imbuyu din ne inlibed din ded ibehey te Magbebaye.” Te neimpusan e seini, nanguli e sikandan.

18 And Samwil continued serving the Lord and he dressed a cloth named ipud. 19 Each year, his mother would make like a small whole_dress that has a long sleeve, and she would bring this to Samwil when the couple went to Silu for sacrificing each year's sacrifice. 20 And Ili blessed Ilkana and his spouse saying, “May you(sg) be given additional children by the Lord by_means of your(sg) spouse to replace the (one that) she requested and (which) she just returned by giving to the Lord.” When this finished, they went_home(pl).

21 Ne impanalanginan te Magbebaye si Hana. Ne nakaanak pad sikandin te tatelu ne me lukes wey daruwa ne me malitan. Ne migtulin ka bate ne si Samwil ne migpamakey te Magbebaye.

21 The Lord blessed Hana. And she became_pregnant and gave_birth to three more males and two females. And the child Samwil grew and served the Lord.

Si Ili wey ka me anak din

Eli and his children

22 Na, kuntee te buyag e amana si Ili, narineg din ka langun ne inggimu te me anak din diye te langun ne matig-Israil wey ka peggulid dan te me malitan ne migtrabahu diye te gumawan peendiye te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan. 23 Ne ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Mania te inggimu niyu seini? Narineg ku puun te langun ne etew ka mareet ne me himu niyu. 24 Peen-enengi niyud sika me anak! Kene ne meupiya ne guhuren ka narineg ku puun te keet-etawan te Magbebaye! 25 Ke egpakasale ka sabeka ne etew diye te duma rin, egpataliware ka Magbebaye kandan. Piru ke egpakasale ka etew te Magbebaye, hentew naa ka egpataliware kandan?”

22 So_then, now that Ili was very old, he heard all that was done by his children to all the (ones) from_Israil and their lying_with the women who worked at the doorway towards_there to the Tent of Meeting. 23 And he said to them, “Why do you(pl) do this? I've heard from all the people (about) your(pl) bad acts. 24 Cease(pl) that children! The story that I hear from the people of the Lord isn't good! 25 If a (LIT one) person sins against another, the Lord will_mediate (LIT will_cause_to_be_between) them. But if the person sins against the Lord, who then will_mediate them?”

Piru ware dan pammineha ka amey ran tenged su igkeupii e te Magbebaye ne eggimatayan sikandan tenged te me sale dan.

But they didn't listen to the word(s) of their father because the Lord desired for them to_be_killed.

26 [xr]And Samwil continued to grow and he was liked by the Lord and by people.

Ka pegtagne meyitenged te pamilya ni Ili

The predicting concerning the family of Eli

27 Ne due prupita[fn] te Manama ne miggendiye ki Ili ne migkahi, “Seini ka ingkahi te Magbebaye, ‘Migpeila a diye te kaapuan nu ne si Aarun wey te me kabuhalan din te timpu ne uripen pad sikandan te Hari te Ihiptu. 28 [xra][xrb]In-alam ku si Aarun puun te langun ne pamilya te Israil eyew egkeyimu ne talagpanubad ne egpamakey diye te altar ne tutunganan te igpanubad wey egtutung te insinsu. Egsaluub sikandin te mateles ne kumbale ne egngaranan te ipud diye te tangkaan ku. Imbehey ku degma diye te pamilya rin ka langun ne igpanubad ne egtutungen ne egpuun diye te keet-etawan te Israil. 29 Ne kuntee, mania te imbaley-baley niyu ka igmanubad wey ka me halad ne insuhu ku ne igpeyimu te me etew? Mania Ili te subla nu pad tahura ka anak nu ne me lukes du te pegtahud nu keddi? Impalambeg nu sikandan pinaahi te meupiya ne baad te langun ne igmanubad te keet-etawan ku ne matig-Israil.’

27 And there_was a prophet[fn] of God who went to Ili and said, “This is what the Lord said, ‘I made_ (myself) _known to your(sg) fore_father Aaron and to his descendants at the time when he (was) still a slave to the king of Ihiptu. 28 [xra][xrb]I chose Aarun from all the families of Israil to become a sacrificer to serve at the altar where_ the sacrifices _be_burned and to burn incense. He will_dress in a beautiful shirt named ipud in my presence (LIT in front of me). I also gave to his family all the burnt sacrifices from the people of Israil. 29 And now, why are you(pl) insulted/blasphemed the sacrifices and offerings which I commanded people to do? Why Ili that you(sg) greatly respect your(sg) male children more than your(sg) respect of me? You(sg) have caused_ them _to_be_fattened by means of the good portion of all the sacrifices of my people from_Israil.’

30 “Purisu migkahi ka Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil, ‘Migsaad a ne egpamakey keddi ka kabuhalan nu wey ka kabuhalan te amey nu te ware egtamanan.’ Piru sikeddi se Magbebaye, migpanengneng, ‘Kene ku sika eggimuwen su ka migtahud keddi, egtahuren ku degma wey ka miglemet keddi, eglemetan ku degma. 31 Egginguma ka aldew ne egdereetan kud e ka kabuhalan nu wey ka kabuhalan te amey nu su eyew ware due te pamilya nu ne egpekeyinguma te kabuyahi rin. 32 Ne eg-antus ka wey egkasekel ka te Israil tenged te egkakita nu ne keupianan ne igbehey ku kandan, piru ware mule kabuhalan nu ne egkabuyag pad human egpatey. 33 Sabeka re ne etew ne egpuun te kabuhalan nu ka kene ku eggimatayan su eyew egpakapabulus sikandin ka egpamakey keddi isip talagpanubad. Piru egpakabaye sikandin te subla ne keyirapan. Ne ka langun ne kabuhalan nu, egpatey ne kene pad ne me buyag. 34 [xr]Egkaamin egpatey ka daruwa ne anak nu ne si Hupni wey si Pinihas te sabeka re ne adlew isip palinneu ne malehet ka ingkahi ku. 35 Ne eg-alam a te matinumanen ne talagpanubad ne eggimu ke nekey ka kayi te pusung ku wey suman-suman. Egtamengan ku sikandin wey ka kabuhalan din eyew egpamakey sikandan te in-alam ku ne Hari te ware egtamanan. 36 Ne ka tagse sabeka ne kabuhalan nu ne kene pad egpatey, eggendiye te sika ne talagpanubad wey egpeyid-u-hid-u ne egbehayan te seleppi wey paan. Ne eghangyu sikandan ne eggimuwen ne talagbulig te talagpanubad eyew egpakakeen de.’ ”

30 “Therefore the Lord, the God of Israil said, ‘I promised that your(sg) descendants and the descendants of your(sg) father would serve me without ending.’ But I the Lord, informs, ‘I won't do that because the (one who) respects me, I will_ also _respect and the (one who) mocks me, I will_ also _mock. 31 The day will_come when I will_destroy your(sg) descendants and the descendants of your(sg) father so_that no (one) there in your(sg) family will_reach his/her old_age. 32 And you(sg) will_be_suffered and jealous at Israil because you(sg) will_see the blessing that I will_give to them, but no_(one) in your(sg) family who will_reach old_age before dying. 33 Only one person from your(sg) descendants that I won't kill so_that he will_continue to serve me as a sacrificer. But he will_go_through severe sufferings. And all of your(sg) descendants, will_be_killed(pl) when not yet old(pl). 34 [xr]Your(sg) two children Hupni and Pinihas will_die simultaneouslyXXX as a sign that what_ I've _said is true. 35 And I will_choose a righteous sacrificer who will_do what is in my heart and mind. I will_watch_over him and his descendants so_that they will_ always _serve my chosen king without ending. 36 And each one from your(sg) descendants who hasn't yet died, will_go to that sacrificer and plead to be given money and bread. And they will_bargain to become a helper for the sacrificer just in_order to be_able_to_eat.’ ”

Ka peg-umew te Manama ki Samwil

The calling of Samwil by God

31 Te seeye ne timpu, migpamakey te Magbebaye ne Manama si Samwil pinaahi te peg-ikul te me suhu ni Ili. Te seeye ne timpu, salimbeka naan de egpeuyan te lalag ka Magbebaye wey salimbeka naan de ka igmakita rin.

31 At that time, Samwil served the Lord God by_means of his following the commands of Eli. At that time, there were just a few bringing the word of the Lord and just a few that he shown_(something)_through.

2 Te seeye ne timpu, kenad amana egpakameleg-meleg si Ili. Sabeka ne marusilem, miglipereng e sikandin diye te eggibhibatan din. 3 Ne si Samwil, diye miglipereng te timplu te Magbebaye ne intahuan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan. Te kene pad egkapawe, te migsiha pad ka sulu te Manama, 4 in-umew te Magbebaye si Samwil te migkahi, “Samwil! Samwil!” Ne mig-inse sikandin, “Nekey-a ahalen?” 5 Ne migpallahuy e sikandin peendiye ki Ili ne mig-inse, “Mania te in-umew a nikeykew ahalen?”

2 At that time, Eli could no_longer see_clearly. One night, he asleep in his lying_place. 3 And Samwil, slept in the temple of the Lord where the Container of the Agreement was stored. Before it dawned, when the lamp of God still burned, 4 the Lord called Samwil saying, “Samwil! Samwil!” And he answered, “What master?” 5 And he ran to Eli and said, “Why are_ you(sg) _calling me master?”

Piru migtabak si Ili, “Ware ku umawa sikeykew. Libed kad lipereng.” Purisu miglibed e sikandin wey miggibat e.

But Eli said, “I didn't call you(sg). Go_back(sg) to sleep.” Therefore he went_back and lay down.

6 Piru mig-abey e man-e mig-umew ka Magbebaye ne migkahi, “Samwil!” Ne mig-enew si Samwil wey miggendiye ki Ili wey migkahi, “Mania te in-umew ad e man-e nikeykew ahalen?”

6 But the Lord again called and said, “Samwil!” And Samwil arose and went to Eli and said, “Why are_you(sg)_calling me again master?”

Piru migkahi si Ili, “Tatu, ware ku umawa sikeykew. Libed kad lipereng.”

But Eli said, “Boy, I didn't call you(sg). Go_back(sg) to sleep.”

7 Te seini ne timpu, ware pad nekeila si Samwil te Magbebaye tenged su ware pad migpakiglalag kandin ka Magbebaye. 8 Te igkatelu e ne peg-umew te Magbebaye ki Samwil, mig-enew sikandin wey miggendiye ki Ili wey migkahi, “Mania te in-umew ad man-e nikeykew ahalen?”

7 At this time, Samwil didn't recognize the Lord because the Lord hadn't yet spoken to_him. 8 At the third calling of the Lord to Samwil, he arose and went to Eli and said, “Why are_you(sg)_calling me again master?”

Ne dutu, nasabut e ni Ili ne ka Magbebaye bes ka mig-umew te bate.9 Sikan naa ka ingkahiyan din e si Samwil, “Libed kad hibat wey emun ke eg-abayan ka eg-umawa, tabaka nu sikandin te eggenendue, ‘Lalag ka, Magbebaye ne Manama, su egpammineg a se suluhuanen nu.’ ” Sikan naa ka miggendiyad e sikandin te sinabeng din wey miggibat e mig-abey.

And there, Eli understood that the Lord [surprise] (was the one who) had called the child.9 So then he said to Samwil, “Go_back(sg) to lie_down and if you(sg) are called again, answer(sg) him going, ‘Speak(sg), Lord God, because I your(sg) servant am_listening.’ ” That's why he went to his room and lay_down again.

10 Migpakita ka Manama wey migsasindeg diye te lenged ni Samwil, ne migpangumew iling te hun-a, “Samwil! Samwil!”

10 And the Lord approached and stood there by Samwil, and called just_like at first, “Samwil! Samwil!”

Ne migtabak si Samwil, “Lalag ka, Magbebaye, su egpammineg a se suluhuanen nu.”

And Samwil answered, “Speak(sg), Lord, because I your(sg) servant is listening.”

11 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye si Samwil, “Mahaan kud e eggimuwa ka eggimuwen ku kayi te Israil. Ne egkaaldek iya ka langun ne egpakarineg kayi. 12 Te sika ne aldew, eggimuwen kud e diye ki Ili ka langun ne ingkahi ku meyitenged te pamilya rin. 13 Ne ingkahiyan kud e sikandin te mahaan kud e egduseyi te ware egtamanan ka pamilya rin tenged te sale te me anak din ne me lukes ne iyan ka pegbaley-baley ran keddi. Natahaan din seeye piru ware din sikandan sapari. 14 Sikan naa ka migpahunlibet a diye te pamilya ni Ili ne kene iya egkaawe ka me sale dan te ware egtamanan pinaahi te pegpanubad wey ke halad naa.”

11 And the Lord said to Samwil, “I will_ soon _do what_ I _am_going_to_do here in Israil. And all those who hear this will_be_afraid. 12 On that day, I will_do to Eli all that I said concerning his family. 13 And I already told him that I would soon curse his family without ending due to the sin of his male children which is blaspheming me. He knew that but he didn't repremand them. 14 So then I oath to Eli's family that their sins wouldn't be removed until without ending by_means of sacrificing or by an offering.”

Ka pegnangen ni Samwil ki Ili te inlalag te Manama kandin

The informing of Ili by Samwil of what God told him

15 Ne miglipereng si Samwil taman te maselem. Te mig-enew e sikandin, inlukatan din ka me gumawan te baley te Magbebaye. Naaldek si Samwil ne egnangen ki Ili te impakita te Magbebaye kandin. 16 Piru in-umew sikandin ni Ili ne migkahi, “Tatu, Samwil.”

15 And Samwil slept until morning. On his arising, he opened the doorways of the house of the Lord. Samwil was afraid to inform Eli what God had shown to_him. 16 But he was called by Eli who said, “Boy, Samwil.”

Ne migtabak si Samwil, “Nekey ahalen?”

And Samwil answered, “What master?”

17 Ne mig-inse si Ili, “Nekey-a ka inlalag te Magbebaye keykew? Kene nu seini iheles keddi. Egdusaan ka te Magbebaye te mangune-kune ke kene nu ignangen keddi ka langun ne inlalag din keykew.” 18 Sikan naa ka innangenan e sikandin ni Samwil wey warad iya inneles din kandin. Ne migkahi si Ili, “Magbebaye seeye, wey igpeyimu kandin ke nekey ka meupiya diye te kandin.”

17 And Eli asked, “What did the Lord say to_you(sg)? Don't(sg) hide it from_me. You(sg) will_be_cursed terribly by the Lord if you(sg) don't tell me all that he told you(sg).” 18 That's why he was_told by Samwil and he didn't indeed hide (anything) from_him. And Eli said, “That (was the) Lord, and he will_have_done whatever (seems) good to him.”

19 Migtulin si Samwil ne migdumaan te Magbebaye wey natuman iya ka langun ne inlalag din. 20 Ne nakataha ka langun ne me matig-Israil puun te Dan peendiye te Birsiba ne malehet si Samwil ne prupita te Magbebaye. 21 Ne migpabulus migpakita ka Magbebaye wey migpanengneng ki Samwil diye te Silu pinaahi te pegpakiglalag kandin.

19 Samwil grew and was accompanied by the Lord and all that he had said was indeed fulfilled. 20 All the (ones) from_Israil from Dan towards Birsiba knew that Samwil was a/the true prophet of the Lord. 21 And the Lord continued to show and reveal (himself) Samwil there at Silu by_means of speaking_with him.

41 Ne nekeempet te intiru ne Israil ka lalag ni Samwil.

41 And the word(s) of Samwil covered all Israil.

Ka pegkaahew te Tahuanan te Kasabutan

The snatching of the Container of the Agreement

Te seeye ne timpu, migpakigbunu ka me matig-Israil te me matig-Pilistiya. Ne migkekampu ka me matig-Israil diye te Ibinisir wey diye degma migkekampu ka me matig-Pilistiya te Apik.2 Ne migluyud miglusud ka me matig-Pilistiya ka egpakig-ehet te me matig-Israil. Te egpabunbunuey e sikandan, natalu te me matig-Pilistiya ka me matig-Israil wey namatayan sikandan te hapit eghep-at ne libu (4,000) ne etew diye te bunuanan. 3 Te peg-uli te nasame ne me matig-Israil ne sundalu diye te kampu ran, migkahi e ka me igdatu te Israil, “Mania te intuhut te Magbebaye ne Manama ne natalu ki te me matig-Pilistiya? Eg-uyanen ta kayi ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye puun te Silu eyew egdumaan ki nikandin wey egluwasan puun te me kuntere ta.” 4 [xr]Sikan naa ka migsuhu sikandan te me etew te peggendiye te Silu eyew eg-angey te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, ne migpinnuu diye te trunu rin elat-elat te daruwa ne larawan te kirubin[fn] ne diye te ampew te Tahuanan te Kasabutan. Ne migduma te migkuwa te Tahuanan te Kasabutan ka daruwa ne anak ni Ili, ne si Hupni wey si Pinihas.

At that time, the (ones) from_Israil fought against the (ones) from_Pilistiya. And the (ones) from_Israil camped at Ibinisir and the (ones) from_Pilistiya likewise camped at Apik.2 The (ones) from_Pilistiya lined_upXXX to attack the (ones) from_Israil. When they were fighting_each_other, the (ones) from_Israil lost to the (ones) from_Pilistiya and they were_killed(pl) to almost four thousand (4,000) people there at the fighting_ground. 3 On the returning_home of the remainder of the soldiers from_Israil to their camp, the leaders of Israil said, “Why did the Lord God allow that we(incl) were_defeated by the (ones) from_Pilistiya? Let us(incl) bring here the Container of the Agreement of the Lord from Silu so_that we(incl) will_be_accompanied by him and saved from our(incl) enemies.” 4 [xr]So then they commanded (some) people to go to Silu in_order to get the Container of the Agreement of the Very Strong Lord, who sits on his thone between two images of cherubim[fn] on top of the Container of the Agreement. The two children of Eli, Hupni and Pinihas accompanied to get the Container of the Agreement.

5 Te pegkeuma te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye diye te kampu, migmanguleyi e te heemeni ka langun ne me matig-Israil wey nawelwel ka tane. 6 Te pegkarineg te me matig-Pilistiya te pegpanguleyi dan, migkahi e sikandan, “Nekey-a ka igpasabut te heemeni ne pegpanguleyi diye te kampu te me Hibruwanen?” Te pegkanengnengi ran ne diyad te kampu ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan, 7 nenaaldek e ka me matig-Pilistiya wey migkahi, “Due sabeka ne manama ne migginguma diye te kampu ran! Mekeyid-u-hid-u ki su ware de due neyitabu ne iling kayi bunsud pad dengan! 8 Mekeyid-u-hid-u ki! Hentew naa ka egpakaluwas kanta puun te seini se maresen ne me manama? Seini ka me manama ne migpangimatey te me matig-Ihiptu pinaahi te langun ne klasi te karereetan diye te disirtu! 9 Piru egpakannekal ki se me matig-Pilistiya wey igpapitew ta ka pegkalukes ta, su ke kene, egkeuripen ki te me Hibruwanen iling te uripen ta dengan sikandan. Igpapitew ta ka pegkalukes ta wey egpakig-ehet ki iya kandan.”

5 On the arrival in the camp of the Container of the Agreement of the Lord, all the (ones) from_Israil shouted intensely and the ground shook. 6 When the (ones) from_Pilistiya heard their shouting, they said, “What is the meaning of this intense shouting in the camp of the Hibruwanons?” When they found_out that the Container of the Agreement was there in the camp, 7 the (ones) from_Pilistiya were_afraid(pl) and said, “There_is a god which_has_arrived to their camp! We(incl) are to_be_pitied because nothing like that has happened ever before! 8 We(incl) are_to_be_pitied(pl)! Who then can_save us(incl) from these powerful gods? These (are) the gods that killed(pl) the (ones) from_Ihiptu by_means of all kinds of destruction in the desert! 9 But we(incl) from_Pilistiya will_be_strong and we(incl) will_show our(incl) manhood, because if not, we(incl) will_be_enslaved to the Hibruwanons like they were our(incl) slaves before. We(incl) will_show our(incl) manhood and we(incl) will_ indeed _attack them.”

10 Sikan naa ka migpakig-ehet ka me matig-Pilistiya wey natalu ran ka me matig-Israil. Masalig amana ka migpatey te sundalu te Israil. Namatayan sikandan te tatelu ne pulu ne libu (30,000) ne me sundalu wey namallahuy e peendiye te ugpaan dan ka nasame ne me matig-Israil. 11 Ne naahew ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama wey namatey ka daruwa ne anak ni Ili ne si Hupni wey si Pinihas.

10 That's why the (ones) from_Pilistiya attacked and they defeated the (ones) from_Israil. Very many soldiers of Israil were_killed(pl). They killed(pl) thirty thousand (30,000) soldiers and the remainder of the (ones) from_Israil ran(pl) to their homes. 11 And the Container of the Agreement of God was_taken and Hupni and Pinihas the two children of Eli were_killed.

Ka pegpatey ni Ili

The death of Eli

12 Ne due sabeka ne etew ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin ne nakapallahuy puun te bunuanan wey nekeuma sikandin diye te Silu te sikan ded ne aldew. Inggisi din ka kumbale din wey intahuan din te tane ka ulu rin isip pegpakita te peglungku din. 13 Te pegginguma rin, diye migpinpinnuu si Ili te pinnuuwan din diye te ilis te dalan ka egmemetmet diye te kewun-an su amana sikandin nalaggew te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama. Te pegginguma te etew diye te siyudad, in-empet din e ihuhud ka neyitabu wey migpandalawit e ka langun ne nakarineg. 14 Te pegkarineg ni Ili te kahulub, mig-inse e sikandin, “Nekey-a ka igkewukag dan?” Ne migdagdahew miggendiye ka etew ki Ili eyew te pegpangguhud kandin. 15 Ne siyam e ne pulu wey walu (98) ka idad ni Ili wey egpangalap-halap naan de se pegtengteng din, sikan naa ka kene din e egpakameleg-meleg. 16 Ne migkahiyan te etew si Ili, “Puun e pad te bunuanan. Migpallahuy a puun diye te seini ne aldew.”

12 And there_was one person from the descendants of Binhamin who ran from the battle_ground and he arrived at Silu on that same day. He tore his clothes and he put dirt on his head as a sign of his mourning. 13 On his arrival, Eli was sitting there on his seat there at the edge of the path staring ahead because he was very sad about the Container of the Agreement of God. When the person arrived in the city, he told everywhere what_had_happened and the all who heard (it) wailed already. 14 When Eli heard the noise, he asked, “What are they stirred_up_about?” And the person quickly went to Eli in_order for telling him. 15 And the age of Eli was ninety-eight (98) and his eyes were just fading, so then he couldn't see_clearly. 16 And the person told Eli, “I've just come from the battle_ground. I ran from there this day.”

Ne mig-inse si Ili, “Tatu, nekey-a ka neyitabu?”

And Eli asked, “Boy, what happened?”

17 Ne migtabak ka etew ne migpangguhud, “Natalu te me matig-Pilistiya ka me matig-Israil wey namallahuy e sikandan. Masalig ka migpatey ne me sundalu ta lagkes ka daruwa ne me anak nu ne si Hupni wey si Pinihas, wey naahew ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan.”

17 And the person answered and storied, “The (ones) from_Israil lost to the (ones) from_Pilistiya and they ran(pl). Many of our(incl) soldiers were_killed including your(sg) two children Hupni and Pinihas, and the Container of the Agreement was_taken.”

18 Te pegdawit te etew te Tahuanan te Kasabutan, neulug e si Ili ne nakaley-ang puun te pinnuuwan din diye te kakiliran te gumawan te lungsud. Nahepu ka lieg din wey namatey e sikandin tenged su mabehat sikandin wey buyag e. Neyimu sikandin ne pangulu te Israil te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un.

18 When the person mentioned the Container of the Agreement, Eli just fell_over_backwards off his seat there at the edge of the doorway of the town. His neck was broken and he died because he was heavy and already old. He became leader of Israil for forty (40) years.

Ka pegpatey te asawa ni Pinihas

The death of the spouse of Pinihas

19 Te seeye ne timpu, egkaberes ka ambey ni Ili ne asawa ni Pinihas wey mahaan e eglesuti. Te pegkarineg din te guhuren ne naahew ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan wey namatey e ka anuhang din wey ka asawa rin, sahuhune ne egkasakitan e sikandin. Miglesut ka bate piru subla ne masakit ka inggeram din te inlesutan. 20 Te egkapatey e sikandin, ingkahiyan sikandin te me malitan ne mig-uyamu kandin, “Kene ka kalaggew su lukes ka anak nu.” Piru ware sikandin migtabak wey ke miglinga-linga naa. 21 Ne ingngaranan din ki Ikabud[fn] ka bate te migkahi, “Warad e ka katelesan te Israil,” su naahew e ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan wey namatey e ka anuhang din wey ka iglukes din. 22 Ne migkahi pad man-e sikandin, “Warad e ka katelesan te Israil su naahew e ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan.”

19 At that time, the daughter-in-law of Eli the spouse of Pinihas was pregnant and close to giving_birth. When she heard the story that the Container of the Agreement was_taken and that her parent-in-law and her spouse had died, suddenly she had_pain. The child was_born but what she felt in giving_birth was great pain. 20 At her dying, she was spoken_to by the woman who was midwifing her, “Don't(sg) be sad because your(sg) child is a male.” But she didn't answer or take_notice. 21 She named the child Ikabud[fn] saying, “Israil has no_more glory,” because the Container of the Agreement had been_taken and her parent-in-law and her husband had died. 22 And she also said, “Israil has no_more glory because the Container of the Agreement has been_taken.”

Ka peg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan diye te Asdud

The bringing of the Container of the Agreement to Asdud

51 Te pegkaahew e te me matig-Pilistiya te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama, in-uyan dan e seini puun te Ibinisir peendiye te Asdud. 2 Ne in-uyan dan seini diye te timplu te diyus-diyus dan ne si Dagun wey diye dan seini itahu te andang te larawan din. 3 Te peggimata te me etew te Asdud te seup ne maselem, nakita ran ne nakalangkeb e ka larawan ni Dagun diye te tane, diye te tangkaan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Sikan naa ka ingkuwa ran e ka larawan ni Dagun wey inlibed dan e itahu diye te natahuan kayi. 4 Piru te peggimata ran te seup ne meselem, nakalangkeb e man-e ka larawan ni Dagun diye te tane, diye te tangkaan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye. Ne ka ulu wey ka me belad kayi, nenatempug e wey diyad nakatahu te gumawan. Ka lawa naan de kayi ka nasame. 5 Purisu ka me talagpanubad ni Dagun wey ka langun ne egseled diye te timplu rin diye te Asdud, kenad e egdiek diye te gumawan taman kuntee.

51 After the taking by the (ones) from_Pilistiya of the Container of the Agreement of God, they brought it from Ibinisir to Asdud. 2 And they brought it to the temple of Dagun their god and they put (it) beside him. 3 At the waking of the people of Asdud the next morning, they saw that Dagun's image had_fallen_face_down on the ground, there in front of the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God. So then they got Dagun's image and returned (it) to its place. 4 But at their waking the next morning, Dagun's image had again fallen_facedown on the ground, in front of the Container of the Agreement of (the) Lord. And its head and arms/hands, were cut_off(pl) and were_there in the doorway. Only just its body remained. 5 Therefore the Dagun's sacrificers and all who enter his temple there at Asdud, no_longer step on the doorway until now.

Ka me siyudad ne inlegparan te Manama

The cities punished by God

6 Impatamtamanan legpari te Magbebaye ka keet-etawan te Asdud wey ka marani ne me bariyu kayi. Impaantus din amana sikandan pinaahi te masumpit ne me buu. 7 Te pegkakita te me etew te Asdud te neyitabu, migkahi e sikandan, “Keilangan ne kene egpakatetahu kayi ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama te Israil su impaantus ki nikandin wey ka diyus-diyus ta ne si Dagun.” 8 Purisu impeumew ran ka langun ne pangulu te me matig-Pilistiya wey mig-insaan, “Nekey-a ka eggimuwen ta te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama te Israil?”

6 The Lord severely punished the people of Asdud and the nearby barrios. He caused_ them _to_suffer greatly with severe swellings. 7 When the people of Asdud saw what_happened, they said, “It's_necessary that the Container of the Agreement of the God of Israil is not placed here because we(incl) and our(incl) god Dagun are caused_ by_him _to_suffer.” 8 Therefore they called all the leaders of the (ones) from_Pilistiya and asked_them, “What shall we(incl) do_with the Container of the Agreement of the God of Israil?”

Ne migtabak sikandan, “Keilangan ne eg-uyanen seini diye te Gat.” Purisu in-uyan dan e ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan diye te Gat.9 Piru te diyad e seini te Gat, inlegparan e degma te Magbebaye ka me etew te sika ne siyudad—kanakan ma wey se buyag. Nenaaldek amana sikandan su impatubuan ma sikandan te Magbebaye te masumpit ne buu. 10 Sikan naa ka indulung dan e diye te Ikrun ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama, piru te igpaseled dan e seini diye te Ikrun, migmanguleyi e ka keet-etawan diye, “In-uyan dan kayi te kanta ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama eyew te peggimatey kanta langun.” 11 Sikan naa ka impeumew ran ka langun ne me pangulu te matig-Pilistiya wey migkahiyan, “Ipariyu niyu kayi ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama te Israil. Iuli niyu red seini diye te migpuunan kayi, su ke kene, egkengamatey ki langun.” Nakahi ran seeye su migbunsud man e ka peglegpad te Manama te siyudad. Nenaaldek sikandan su masalig ma ka migpatey. 12 Ne impanlebahan ka me etew ne ware migpatey wey nekeuma diye te langit ka pegpangananey ran.

They answered, “It needs to be_taken to Gat.” Therefore they took the Container of the Agreement to Gat.9 But while it was at Gat, the people in that city—single or old were also punished by the Lord. They were_ very _afraid because the Lord caused_ them _to_swell with great boil(s). 10 So then they carried the Container of the Agreement of God to Ikrun, but on their bringing_ it _into Ikrun, the people there shouted, “They've brought the Container of the Agreement of God here to us(incl) in_order to kill us(incl) all.” 11 So then they called all the leaders of the (ones) from_Pilistiya and told_them, “Take_away(pl) the Container of the Agreement of the God of Israil from here. Just return(pl) it to where_it_came_from, because if not, we(incl) will_ all _die.” They said that because God had begun to punish the city. They were_afraid(pl) because many had died(pl). 12 The people who didn't die swelled(pl) and their requesting reached heaven/sky.

Ka peg-uli te Tahuanan te Kasabutan

The returning of the Container of the Agreement

61 Te timpu ne diye pad te me matig-Pilistiya ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama te pitu ne bulan, 2 impeumew te pangulu te me matig-Pilistiya ka me talagpanubad wey ka egmahehane wey ingkahiyan, “Nekey-a ka eggimuwen ta te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye te Israil? Nangeni key ke egmenuwen ney te eg-uli seini diye te migpuunan kayi?”

61 At the time that the Container of the Agreement of Lord God was still in the (ones) from_Pilistiya for seven months, 2 the sacrificers and the future_tellers were_sent_for by the leader(s) of the (ones) from_Pilistiya and were_told, “What shall we(incl) do with the Container of the Agreement of the Lord of Israil? Inform us(excl) what we(excl) should do to return_ this _home to where_it_came_from?”

3 Ne migtabak sikandan, “Ke ig-uli niyu ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Manama, parumeyi niyu seini te halad isip bayad te sale niyu. Ne egkeulian kew e wey egkatahaan niyu ke mania te egpabul-bulusan kew nikandin te eglegpad.”

3 And they answered, “If you(pl) return the Container of the Agreement of God, accompany it with an offering as a payment for your(pl) sin(s). And you(pl) will_recover and you(pl) will_know why you(pl) are continuing to be_punished by him.”

4 Ne mig-inse sikandan, “Nekey ne halad isip bayad te sale ka igpeuyan ney diye te kandin?”

4 And they asked, “What offering as a payment of sin(s) shall we(excl) send to him?”

Migtabak sikandan, “Lalimma ne timman ne bulawan ne impeiling te buu wey lalimma ne timman ne bulawan ne impeiling te ambew, sumale te kasalig te me pangulu te matig-Pilistiya, tenged su nekeg-iling kew re langun te me pangulu niyu ne nakaneem-neem te sika ne me karereetan.5 Purisu, himu kew te larawan te me buu wey te me ambew ne migdereet te nasud wey tahura niyu ka Manama te Israil su kema ke igsanggel rin e ka peglegpad kaniyu, te me manama niyu, wey te nasud niyu. 6 Mania te makehal ka me ulu[fn] niyu iling te inggimu te me matig-Ihiptu wey te Hari dan? Ware dan naa peyipanawa ka me Israilita human sikandan duseyi patamtamani te Manama? 7 Sikan naa, andam kew te iyam ne kerumata wey daruwa ne inayan ne baka ne ware pad nasangeni te yuggu. Sangeni niyu seini te kerumata piru kene niyu iparuma kandan ka me nati kayi. 8 Ne kua niyu ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama wey irulan niyu te kerumata. Ne itahu niyu degma diye te andang kayi ka kehun ne intahuan te larawan ne me bulawan ne igparuma niyu isip halad ne bayad te sale. Ne peyipanawa niyu ka me baka wey balahara niyu re due ke hendei seini egpabaye. 9 Piru pipitawa niyu ke egpabulus naa seini diye te Bit-Simis ne sakup te tane te me matig-Israil, su sika ka palinneu ne ka Magbebaye iya te Israil ka miggimu te dakel ne karereetan. Piru ke kene, egpakakahi ki te kene ne ka Magbebaye te Israil ka miglegpad kanta, ke kene, neyitabu de due seini.”

They answered, “Five pieces of gold made_like a swelling and five pieces of gold made_like a rat/mouse, according to the number of leaders of the (ones) from_Pilistiya, because all of you(pl) and your(pl) leaders are just the same that experienced that destructions.5 Therefore, make(pl) images of gold swellings and rats/mice that destroy the nation and respect(pl) the God of Israil because what_if he'll stop punishing you(pl), your(pl) gods, and your(pl) nation. 6 Why are your(pl) heads[fn] hard like what_ the (ones) from_Ihiptu and their king _did? After God finished toying with them, didn't they send_off the (ones) from_Israil?XXX 7 So then, prepare(pl) a new cart and two mother cows who haven't yet been_installed with yoke(s). Install(pl) them to the cart but don't(pl) let_ its calves _accompany. 8 And get(pl) the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God and haul it on the cart. And also put(pl) beside it a box with the gold images that you(pl) are sendings as an offering payment for sin(s) put_in_it. And send_off(pl) the cows and just ignore(pl) them wherever they go. 9 But watch(pl) it if it goes to the Bit-Simis which under_the_jurisdiction of the land of the (ones) from_Israil, because that a sign that it's indeed the Lord of Israil who made the big destruction. But if not, we(incl) can say that it's not the Lord of Israil that's punished us(incl), but rather, it just happened.”

10 Ne inggimu seini te me etew. Migkuwa sikandan te daruwa ne baka ne inayan wey insangenan dan seini te kerumata wey ingkulung dan ka me nati kayi. 11 Ne indulan dan ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye diye te kerumata wey ka kehun ne intahuan te me bulawan ne impeiling te ambew wey me buu. 12 Ne migpalaheteng migpeendiye te Bit-Simis ka me baka ne mig-ikul te dalan ne egmangngaa-ngaa taheed te eggipanew sikandan. Ne ware suwey-suwey ran wey migsinundul kandan ka me pangulu te me matig-Pilistiya taman diye te katamanan te Bit-Simis.

10 So the people did this. They got two mother cows and installed them to a cart and they fenced_up their calves. 11 And they loaded the Container of the Agreement of the Lord on the cart and the box that had the gold in_the_form_of rat/mouse and swelling(s) put_in. 12 And the cows went_directly to Bit-Simis and followed the path and mooed while they were_walking. And they didn't deviate and the leaders of the (ones) from_Pilistiya followed them to the edge of Bit-Simis.

13 Te seini ne timpu, miggaani te trigu diye te napu ka me etew te Bit-Simis. Te pegtenggak dan, nakita ran ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan. Ne nenaggale sikandan te pegkakita ran kayi. 14 Ne nekeuma ka me baka ne migganuy te kerumata diye te kamet ni Huswi ne matig-Bit-Simis wey migsanggel seini diye te kakiliran te dakel ne batu. Ne ingguhuhus e te me etew ka kerumata diye wey inggimatayan dan e ka me baka wey intutung isip igpanubad te Magbebaye. 15 Te ware dan pad seeye himuwa, impepamaneug pad te me Libita ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan wey ka kehun ne andang kayi ne intahuan te bulawan ne impeiling te ambew wey buu wey in-untud dan e seeye diye te dakel ne batu. Te seeye ne aldew, mighalad pad man-e ka me etew wey migpanubad te egtutungen diye te Magbebaye. 16 Te pegkakita kayi te lalimma ne pangulu te me matig-Pilistiya, nanguli e sikandan diye te Ikrun te sika ne aldew.

13 At this time, the people of Bit-Simis were harvesting wheat in the plain. When they looked up, they saw the Container of the Agreement. And they were_happy(pl) upon their seeing this. 14 And the cows pulling the cart arrived at the field of Huswi from_Bit-Simis and it stopped there beside a large stone. And the people demolished the cart and they killed the cows and burnt (them) as a sacrifice to the Lord. 15 Before they did that, the Levites got_down the Container of the Agreement and the box beside it that was filled with gold in_the_form of rat/mouse and swelling and they placed it on the large stone. That day, the people offered more burnt (things) and sacrificed to the Lord. 16 When the five leaders of the (ones) from_Pilistiya saw this, they returned_home(pl) to Ikrun that day.

Ka me bulawan ne impeiling te buu

The gold in_the_form of swelling(s)

17 Ka lalimma ne bulawan ne impeiling te buu, egpuun te lalimma ne siyudad te me matig-Pilistiya ne iyan sika se siyudad te Asdud, Gasa, Akilun, Gat, wey Ikrun. Impeuyan dan seeye isip halad ne igbayad te me sale dan diye te Magbebaye. 18 Ka me bulawan ne impeiling te me ambew, para seeye te me siyudad ne in-alad wey te nakalingut ne me bariyu ne ware alara ne immanduan te lalimma ne pangulu te me matig-Pilistiya. Ka dakel ne batu diye te kamet ni Huswi ne diye te Bit-Simis ne in-unturan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan ka egpakapamalehet ke nekey ka neyitabu.

17 The five gold (things) that were in_the_form of swellings, were from five cities of the (ones) from_Pilistiya which were the city of Asdud, Gasa, Akilun, Gat, and Ikrun. They sent those as an offering that would_pay for their sins to the Lord. 18 The gold (things) that were in_the_form of rats/mice, they were for the fenced cities and the surrounding unfenced barrios that were commanded by the five leaders of the (ones) from_Pilistiya. The large stone in the field of Huswi in Bit-Simis that the Container of the Agreement was put_on can_prove what had happened.

19 Ne due pitu ne pulu (70) ne etew[fn] ne impangimatayan te Magbebaye diye te Bit-Simis su migpitew ma sikandan te seled te Tahuanan te Kasabutan. Ne miglungku ka keet-etawan tenged te masalig ka impangimatayan te Magbebaye diye te kandan.

19 And there were seventy (70) people[fn] that were_killed by the Lord there at Bit-Simis because they looked inside the Container of the Agreement. And the people mourned due to many being killed by the Lord at their (place).

Ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan diye te Kiryat-Hiyarim

The Container of the Agreement there at Kiryat-Hiyarim

20 Sikan naa ka migkahi ka me etew diye te Bit-Simis, “Hentew-a ka egpakasasindeg diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye, ka matulus ne Manama? Hendei te naa igpeuyan ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye eyew egpakapariyu seini kanta?” 21 Sikan naa ka migsuhu sikandan te egpahuhuren diye te Kiryat-Hiyarim te pegkahi, “In-uli e te me matig-Pilistiya ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye. Angaya niyu seini kayi wey uyana niyu due te kaniyu.”

20 So then the people at Bit-Simis said, “Who is able_to_stand there to (the) front of the Lord, the holy God? Where shall we(incl) send the Container of the Agreement so_that it can_be_distanced from us(incl)?” 21 So then they sent to_tell to Kiryat-Hiyarim to say, “The Container of the Agreement of the Lord has been_returned_home by the (ones) from_Pilistiya. Get(pl) it here and take(pl) it to your(pl) (place).”

71 [xr]Sikan naa ka in-angey e te me matig-Kiryat-Hiyarim ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama wey in-uyan dan e seini diye te baley ni Abinadab ne diye te bubungan. Ne in-alam dan ka anak ni Abinadab ne si Ilisar eyew iyan egtanggu kayi.

71 [xr]So then the (ones) from_Kiryat-Hiyarim took the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God and they brought it to the house of Abinadab there in/on a/the mountain(s). And they chose Ilisar the child of Abinadab to look_after it.

Ka pegmandu ni Samwil te Israil

The commanding of Israil by Samwil

2 Miglihad ka daruwa ne pulu (20) ne leg-un bunsud te peg-uyan te Tahuanan diye te Kiryat-Hiyarim, wey te sika ne me leg-un, miglungku ka keet-etawan te Israil wey migbuyu te bulig diye te Magbebaye.

2 And twenty (20) years passed from the bringing of the Container to the Kiryat-Hiyarim, and at that years, the people of Israil grieved and requested_help from the Lord.

3 Ne ingkahiyan ni Samwil ka langun ne etew te Israil, “Ke egpuun te pusung niyu ka peglibed niyu te Magbebaye, engkeri niyud ka me manama ne lapu wey ka larawan ni Astarut. Ne ibehey niyud ka pusung niyu diye te Magbebaye wey sikandin de simbaa niyu wey egluwasen kew nikandin puun te me matig-Pilistiya.” 4 Ne immandegpak e te me matig-Israil ka me larawan ni Baal wey ni Astarut wey iyan dan naan de insimba ka Magbebaye.

3 And Samwil said to all the people of Israil, “If it's from your(pl) hearts to return(pl) to the Lord, leave_behind(pl) the foreign gods and image of Astarut. And give(pl) your(pl) hearts to the Lord and just worship(pl) him and you(pl) will_be_saved from the (ones) from_Pilistiya by him.” 4 And Israil threw_away the images of Baals and Astarut and they just worshiped the Lord.

5 Ne migkahi si Samwil, “Libulung kew langun se me matig-Israil diye te Mispa su eg-ampu a te Magbebaye para kaniyu.” 6 Sikan naa ka miglibulung sikandan diye te Mispa wey migsakug te weyig wey in-itis dan seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye isip halad. Ne migpuasa sikandan te seeye ne aldew wey migkahi, “Nakasale key te Magbebaye.” Ne iyan migpangulu si Samwil te me matig-Israil diye te Mispa.

5 And Samwil said, “All the (ones) from_Israil gather in Mispa because I will_pray to the Lord for you(pl).” 6 So then they gathered at Mispa and they drew water and they poured_ it _out in front of the Lord as an offering. And they fasted that day and said, “We(excl) have_sinned against the Lord.” And it was Samwil who led the (ones) from_Israil there at Mispa.

7 Te pegkarineg te me matig-Pilistiya ne miglibulung ka keet-etawan te Israil diye te Mispa, migtakereg e ka me pangulu ran eyew te peglusud te me matig-Israil. Te pegkarineg kayi te keet-etawan te Israil, nenaaldek e sikandan. 8 Ne ingkahiyan dan si Samwil, “Kene ka sanggel ka eg-ampu te Magbebaye ne Manama ta eyew egluwasen ki nikandin puun te me matig-Pilistiya.” 9 Sikan naa ka migkuwa si Samwil te karniru ne egsusu pad wey intutung din isip igpanubad te Magbebaye. Migpangananey sikandin te Magbebaye para te me matig-Israil wey intabak sikandin. 10 Taheed te egpanubad pad si Samwil te egtutungen, migparani e ka me matig-Pilistiya eyew te peglusud kandan. Piru te sika ne aldew, imparagsangan te Magbebaye te luhung ne amana ne makeseg ka me matig-Pilistiya wey nenaaldek sikandan wey nenekegsuwey, wey natalu sikandan te me Israilita. 11 Ne migligkat e ka me matig-Israil puun te Mispa wey inlupug dan e ka me matig-Pilistiya taman diye te diddiralem te inged ne Bit-Kar, wey impangimatayan dan sikandan.

7 When the (ones) from_Pilistiya heard that the people of Israil had gathered there at Mispa, their leaders ascended in_order to attack the (ones) from_Israil. When the people of Israil heard this, they were_afraid(pl). 8 And they said to Samwil, “Don't(sg) stop praying to our(incl) Lord God in_order that we(incl) might be_saved from the (ones) from_Pilistiya by_him.” 9 So then Samwil got a sheep that was still suckling and burnt it as a sacrifice to the Lord. He requested of the Lord for the (ones) from_Israil and he was answered (by the Lord). 10 While Samwil was still sacrificing by burning, the (ones) from_Pilistiya approached in_order to attack them. But on that day, the Lord caused_ very strong _thunder_at the (ones) from_Pilistiya and they were_afraid(pl) and separated_from_each_other(pl), and they were_defeated by the Israilita. 11 And the (ones) from_Israil left from Mispa and they chased the (ones) from_Pilistiya up_to_the_area_below the place of Bit-Kar, and they killed them.

12 Ne migkuwa si Samwil te dakel ne batu wey intahu din diye te elat-elat te Mispa wey te Hisana. Ne ingngaranan din seeye te Ibinisir[fn] su migkahi sikandin, “Imbulihan ki te Magbebaye taman kuntee.” 13 Sikan naa ka natalu ka me matig-Pilistiya wey warad e sikandan mig-abey miglusud diye te inged te me matig-Israil tenged su ka Magbebaye ma iya ka migpakig-ehet kandan taheed te neuyag pad si Samwil. 14 Ne naawi e te me matig-Israil ka me siyudad ne naahew te me matig-Pilistiya puun te Ikrun peendiye te Gat wey ka langun ne me sakup kayi. Ne warad e degma migpeehetey ka me matig-Israil wey ka me Amurihanen.

12 And Samwil got a big stone and he placed (it) between Mispa and Hisana. And he named it Ibinisir[fn] because he said, “We(incl) have_been_helped by the Lord until now.” 13 That's why the (ones) from_Pilistiya lost and they didn't repeat invading the place of the (ones) from_Israil because it was the Lord indeed who attacked them while Samwil was still alive. 14 And the (ones) from_Israil recovered the cities that were snatched by the (ones) from_Pilistiya from Ikrun to Gat and everything under their jurisdiction. And the (ones) from_Israil and the Amurihanons no_longer fought_each_other.

15 Migpangulu si Samwil te Israil te intiru ne umul rin. 16 Tagse leg-un, eggipanew si Samwil eyew te pegleuy te Bitil, Gilgal, wey te Mispa eyew te pegpangulu te me matig-Israil te sika ne me inged. 17 Ne eg-uli sikandin diye te Rama te egkeimpusan e ka himu rin su diye ma ka ugpaan din wey sikandin degma ka migmandu te me matig-Israil te sika ne inged. Ne miggimu degma sikandin te altar ne tutunganan te igpanubad diye para te Magbebaye.

15 Samwil led Israil for his entire life. 16 Each year, Samwil went to visit Bitil, Gilgal, and Mispa in_order to led the (ones) from_Israil in those places. 17 And he will_return_home to Rama when he will_finish his work because his residence was there and he also commanded the (ones) from_Israil in that place. And he also made an altar where_ the sacrifices _be_burned there for the Lord.

Ka pegbuyu te me matig-Israil te Hari

The (ones) from_Israil request a king

81 Te egkabuyag e si Samwil, inggimu rin e ne me pangulu te intiru ne Israil ka daruwa ne anak din ne me lukes. 2 Si Huwil ka ngaran te kakey wey si Abiya ka ngaran te hari. Sikandan ka me pangulu te Birsiba. 3 Piru ware sikandan mig-ikul te batasan te amey ran, ke kene, nasi sikandan migsuwey tenged te seleppi. Migdawat sikandan te seleppi ne bayad te pegsupak te eleg ne peggukum.

81 When Samwil was old, he made his two male children leaders over all Israil. 2 The name of the eldest was Huwil and the youngest was Abiya. They were the leaders of Birsiba. 3 But they didn't follow the custom(s) of their father, but rather, instead they deviated due to money. They accepted money which_is payment to disobey the correct(s) judgment.

4 Sikan naa, miglibulung ka langun ne igdatu te Israil wey nangendiye ki Samwil diye te Rama. 5 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan dan sikandin, “Buyag kad e wey ware mig-ikul te batasan nu ka me anak nu. Purisu alam ka te Hari ne egmandu kanami iling te duma ne me nasud.” 6 Ne miglungku si Samwil te pegkahi ran, “Behayi key te Hari eyew egmandu kanami.” Sikan naa ka mig-ampu sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama. 7 Ne ingkahiyan sikandin te Magbebaye, “Tumana nu ka langun ne egbuyuen te keet-etawan keykew su kene ma ne sikeykew ka insamsamilian dan, ke kene, sikeddi ka insamsamilian dan isip Hari dan. 8 Egsamsamilian ka degma nikandan iling te pegsamsamili dan dengan keddi. In-engkeran a nikandan wey migsimba te me diyus-diyus bunsud pad te pegluwas ku kandan diye te Ihiptu taman kuntee. 9 Sikan naa, tumana nu ka inhangyu dan keykew piru panpanayi nu sikandan te mapahetpet wey pangguhuri nu te batasanen te Hari ne egmandu kandan.”

4 So then, all the leaders of Israil gathered and went to Samwil at Rama. 5 [xr]And they said to him, “You(sg) are old and your(sg) children don't follow your(sg) custom(s). Therefore choose(sg) a king to rule us(excl) like other nations.” 6 And Samwil grieved at their saying, “Give us(excl) a king to rule us(excl).” So then he prayed to the Lord God. 7 And he was_told by the Lord, “Obey(sg) all that the people have requested from you(sg) because it's not you(sg) that they are rejecting, but rather, I (am) the (one) they are rejecting as their king. 8 You(sg) are also being_rejected by them like their rejecting me before. I was left_behind by them and (they) worshiped false_gods beginning from my saving them in Ihiptu until now. 9 So then, obey(sg) their request to_you(sg) but warn(sg) them energetically and story(sg) them about the custom of a king who rules them.”

Ka me pegpaney-paney meyitenged te pegmandu te Hari

Warnings about the ruling of a king

10 Sikan naa, impanugtul e ni Samwil ka langun ne inlalag te Magbebaye diye te me etew ne migbuyu kandin te Hari. 11 Ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Seini ka batasan te Hari ne egmandu kaniyu: egkuen din ka me anak niyu ne me lukes wey eggimuwen din sikandan ne me sundalu. Ne ka duma, eggimuwen din ne talag-uyan te me karwahi wey me talagpangudde, wey igpewun-a rin ka duma te me karwahi rin. 12 Ne eg-alam sikandin te egpangulu te libu-libu ne sundalu wey te tiglalimma ne pulu (50) ne sundalu. Egdaru ka duma wey eggaani diye te kamet din, wey ka duma pad kandan eggimu te panganiban te pegpakigbunu wey himan te me karwahi rin. 13 Egkuen din ka anak niyu ne me malitan eyew eggimuwen ne talaggimu te peemut, talagsusuba, wey talaggimu te paan. 14 Egkuen din ka subla ne meupiya ne me kamet niyu, me parasan, wey me ulibuwan niyu. And the Lord answered, “He's hiding there in the things.”

23 Sikan naa ka migpamallahuy e sikandan ka egkuwa ki Saul diye. Te pegsasindeg din e diye te taliware te me etew, subla sikandin ne malangkew te langun, ne ka duma taman de te pamanayen din. 24 Ingkahiyan ni Samwil ka me etew, “Seini ka etew ne in-alam te Magbebaye. Ware egpekeiling kandin te langun ne etew.”

23 So then they ran to get Saul there. When he stood in the middle of the people, he was extremely taller than all, and the others just came to his shoulder. 24 Samwil said to the people, “This is the person who was_chosen by the Lord. There's_none like him among all the people.”

Ne migmanguleyi ka langun ne etew, “Egkeuyag ka Hari!”

And all the people shouted(pl), “May the king live!”

25 Ne innangenan ni Samwil ka me etew te katenged wey katungdanan te Hari. Ne insulat din seini diye te baseen wey diye din itahu te tangkaan te Magbebaye. Ne impeuli din e ka langun ne etew diye te me ugpaan dan. 26 Ne mig-uli e degma si Saul diye te baley rin diye te Gibiya ne migdumaan te me bahani ne imbagget te Manama.[fn] 27 Piru due me etew ne ware gulehud ne migkahi, “Egmenuwen naa te seini ne etew te egluwas kanta?” Ne inlemetan dan si Saul wey ware dan behayi te dasag. Piru migpeeneng-eneng de sikandin.

25 Then Samwil informed the people about the authority and duties of a king. And he wrote this in a document and put it in front of the Lord. And he sent_home all the people to their residences. 26 And Saul went_home also to his house there in Gibiya and was accompanied by (some) heroes who were enthusiastic about God.[fn] 27 But there were people of no worth who said, “How can this person save us(incl)?” And they mocked Saul and they didn't give (him) a gift. But he just stayed_silent.

Natalu ni Saul ka me kabuhalan ni Amun

The descendants of Amun are defeated by Saul

111 Ne miglusuran te kabuhalan ni Amun ne si Hari Nahas duma te me sundalu rin ka inged ne Habis-Gilyad wey inlingutan dan seini. Ne migkahiyan si Nahas te langun ne etew diye te Habis-Gilyad, “Eggimu ki re te kasabutan wey egpasakup key e kaniyu.”

111 The King Nahas the descendant of Amun along_with his soldiers invaded Habis-Gilyad and they surrounded it. And all the people at Habis-Gilyad said to Nahas, “We(incl) will_ just _make an agreement and we(excl) will_come_under_ your(pl) _jurisdiction.”

2 Piru migkahi si Nahas, “Eggimu e re te kasabutan kaniyu ke egsuhut kew ne egkulewuten ku ka igkakawanan ne mata niyu eyew egkeyilawan ka intiru ne Israil.”

2 But Nahas said, “I will_ just _make an agreement with you(pl) if you(pl) agree that your(pl) right eye(s) be gouged_out so_that entire Israil will_be_humiliated.”

3 Ne migkahi ka me pangulu diye te Habis-Gilyad, “Behayi key pa te pitu ne aldew eyew egpakasuhu key pad te egpahuhuren meyitenged due diye te intiru ne Israil. Ke ware egpakaluwas kanami ne eggural key e kaniyu.”

4 Te pegginguma te seeye se me insuhu diye te ugpaan ni Saul diye te Gibiya, impanengneng dan e diye te me etew ka ingkahi ni Nahas. Ne puun due migpandalawit e ka me etew. 5 Te seini ne timpu, sikan pad egginguma si Saul puun te kamet din ne migsinundul te me baka. Ne dutu, mig-inse sikandin, “Nekey-a ka neyitabu te me etew? Mania te migsinehew sikandan?” Purisu impanugtulan dan e sikandin te guhuren te me etew ne egpuun diye te Habis-Gilyad. 6 Te pegkarineg kayi ni Saul, miglene e ka Panisingan te Manama diye te kandin wey migpangebel-ebel e ka langet din. 7 Ne migkuwa sikandin te daruwa ne baka wey intadtad din seini. Ne impeuyan din e seini te seeye se me insuhu peendiye te intiru ne Israil ne egpakahiyen, “Ka minsan hentew ne kene egduma ki Saul wey ki Samwil, egtadtaren degma ka baka rin iling kayi.”

4 When those sent arrived at the residence of Saul at Gibi, they made_known to the people what_ Nahas _had_said. And due to that the people wailed. 5 At this time, Saul had just arrived from his field following the cows. And then, he asked, “What's happened to the people? Why are they crying(pl)?” Therefore they told him the story of the people who had come from Habis-Gilyad. 6 When Saul heard this, the Spirit of God descended on him and his anger smoked. 7 And he took two cows and cut_ them _into_pieces. And he sent these to those who sent(pl) to all Israil and had_(them)_say, “Whoever that doesn't go with Samwil and Saul, his cow will_be_cut_into_pieces like this.”

Ne ingginaaldek te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me matig-Israil, sikan naa ka migpakigsabeke e sikandan kandin.8 Inlibulung ni Saul ka me etew diye te Bisik: tatelu ne gatus ne libu (300,000) ka me matig-Israil wey tatelu ne pulu ne libu (30,000) ka me matig-Huda. 9 Ne impeuli dan e diye te Habis-Gilyad seeye se insuhu duma te seini ne lalag, “Nangeni niyu ka keet-etawan diye te egluwasen e kaaselem sikandan te kene pad egmeudtu.” Te nekeuli e diye te Habis-Gilyad seeye se me insuhu, migpangguhuran dan e ka keet-etawan diye wey nenaggale amana sikandan. 10 Ne ingkahiyan dan ka me kabuhalan ni Amun, “Eggural key e kaaselem kaniyu wey himuwa niyud kayi te kanami ke nekey ka igkeupii niyu.”

And the (ones) from_Israil scared by the Lord God, so then they united with him.8 Saul gathered the people at Bisik: three hundred thousand (300,000) (people) from_Israil and thirty thousand (30,000) (people) from_Judah. 9 And they sent_home those sent_to_tell to Habis-Gilyad along_with this word, “Tell(pl) the people there that they'll be_saved tomorrow before it's noon.” When those (who) sent(pl) arrived_home there at Habis-Gilyad, they told the people there and they were_ very _happy(pl). 10 Therefore they told the descendants of Amun, “Tomorrow we(excl) will_surrender to_you(pl) and do(pl) to us(excl) whatever you(pl) want.”

11 Te seup ne aldew, imbaad e ni Saul ka me etew te tatelu ne punduk. Te eg-ukale e ka manuk, inlusuran dan e ka me kabuhalan ni Amun diye te kampu ran wey impangimatayan dan e seini taman te meudtu. Ne nenekegsuwey namallahuy ka seeye se ware nammatey wey ware minsan daruwa kandan ne nekegduma.

11 The next day, Saul divided the people into three groups. When the chicken(s) crowed, they invaded the descendants of Amun in their camp and they killed(pl) them until noon. And those who weren't killed separated(pl) and fled(pl) and there_wasn't even two of them accompanying_each_other.

The announcing again that Saul is king

12 Ne ingkahiyan si Samwil te me etew, “Hentew-a seeye se migkahi, ‘Eghari bes ubag si Saul?’ Igpaangey ta sikandan su eggimatayan ta.”

12 And the people said to Samwil, “Who were those who said, ‘Will Saul become_king?’ We(incl) will_cause_ them _to_be_fetched because we'll(incl) kill_them.”

13 Piru migkahi si Saul, “Ware etew ne eggimatayan kuntee ne aldew su inluwas te Magbebaye ka Israil te seini ne aldew.” 14 Ne ingkahiyan ni Samwil ka keet-etawan, “Kuwa kew e. Eggendiye ki te Gilgal su ig-abey ta igpanengneng ne si Saul, Hari ta.” 15 Sikan naa ka nangendiyad te Gilgal ka langun ne etew wey inggimu ran e ne Hari si Saul diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. Ne migpanubad sikandan para te keupianan wey miggale-gale amana si Saul wey ka me matig-Israil.

13 But Saul said, “No person will_be_killed this day because the Lord saved Israil on this day.” 14 And Samwil said to the people, “Go_on(pl). Let's(incl) go to Gilgal because we'll(incl) again cause_to_be_known that Saul, is our(incl) king.” 15 So then all the people went to Gilgal and they made Saul their king in front of the Lord. And they sacrificed for peace/prosperity and Saul and the (ones) from_Israil were_enjoying very_much.

Ka pegpanaha-taha ni Samwil

The farewell by Samwil

121 Ne ingkahiyan ni Samwil ka me matig-Israil, “Intuman ku ka langun ne inlalag niyu wey imbehayan ku sikaniyu te Hari ne egmandu kaniyu. 2 Ne kuntee duen e Hari niyu ne egpangulu kaniyu. Piru buyag ad e wey ubanen e, wey derakel e degma ka me anak ku wey duma niyu iya mismu sikandan. 3 Kuntee nangeni a ke nekey ka igpakarew-ey niyu keddi diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama wey diye te tangkaan te Hari ne in-alam din. Duen naa ingkuwa ku ne asnu wey ke baka naa te senge-etew? Duen naa inlimbungan ku wey ke indeeg-deeg ku? Migdawat e naa te seleppi ne bayad te kene ne eleg ne peggukum? Pamaleheti niyu ke nekeyimu a te iling dutu su ig-uli ku seeye kaniyu.”

121 And Samwil said to the (ones) from_Israil, “I've fulfilled all that you(pl) said and I gave you(pl) a king that will_command you(pl). 2 And now you(pl) have a king who will_lead you(pl). Concerning me, I commanded you(pl) from my childhood until now. But I'm old already and gray, and my children are large(pl) and indeed they are among you(pl). 3 Now inform me what you(pl) scold_ me _for in front of the Lord God and in front of the king that he has chosen. Were there any donkey(s) or cow(s) that I took from anyone? Is there (anyone) I cheated or I oppressed? Did I accept money which_is payment to judge incorrectly? Be_honest(pl) if I did anything like that because I'll return it to you(pl).”

4 Migtabak sikandan, “Ware ka migpanlimbung wey migdeeg-deeg kanami wey ware ka degma migkuwa te minsan nekey ne egpuun te senge-etew.”

5 Ne ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Te seini ne aldew, egpakapamalehet ka Magbebaye wey ka Hari ne in-alam din te ware nakita niyu ne seyyup ne neyimu ku.”

Ne migkahi sikandan, “Uya, egpakapamalehet ka Magbebaye.”

And they said, “Yes, the Lord can_witness.”

6 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan ni Samwil ka keet-etawan, “Ka Magbebaye ka mig-alam ki Muwisis wey ki Aarun ne egkeyimu ne pangulu te kabuybuyahan niyu ne me matig-Israil, wey sikandin ka migpalihawang kandan puun te Ihiptu. 7 Ne kuntee, pabulus kew sasindeg due te tangkaan te Magbebaye, taheed te igpasuman-suman ku kaniyu ka langun ne meupiya ne neyimu te Magbebaye kaniyu wey te kabuybuyahan niyu. 8 [xr]Ne migpangananey si Hakub wey ka me anak din te Magbebaye te diye sikandan te Ihiptu. Piru luwasa key kuntee puun te me kuntere ney wey egpamakey key e keykew.’ 11 [xra][xrb][xrc][xrd]Ne insuhu te Magbebaye si Gidyun,[fn] si Barak, si Hipta, wey siak. Ne inluwas ney sikaniyu puun te me kuntere niyu ne miglingut kaniyu. Ne kuntee, warad igkaaldek niyu te peg-ugpe niyu. 12 [xr]Te pegkakita niyu ne eglusuran kew e ni Nahas ne Hari te me kabuhalan ni Amun, migkahiyan ad e nikaniyu, ‘Egkeupian key te Hari ne egmandu kanami,’ minsan se ka Magbebaye ka Hari niyu.

6 [xr]And Samwil said to the people, “The Lord (is) the (one who) chose Moses and Aaron to_become leaders of your(pl) elder(s), and he caused_ them _to_exit Ihiptu. 7 And now, continue(pl) standing there in front of the Lord, while I remind you(pl) all the good_things done by the Lord for_you(pl) and for your(pl) elder(s). 8 [xr]And Hakub and his children requested the Lord while they were in Ihiptu. So then the Lord sent Moses and Aaron and (they were the ones who) caused_ your(pl) elders _to_exit Ihiptu, and the (ones who) caused_ them _to_live in this place. 9 [xra][xrb][xrc]But the people intentionally_forgot their Lord, so then he caused_ them _to_lose to Sisira, the chief soldier of Habin the king of Hasur, and to the (ones) from_Pilistiya, and to the king of Muwab. 10 [xr]And they pleaded to the Lord saying, ‘We(excl) have_sinned because we(excl) left_ you(sg) _behind Lord, and we(excl) served the images of Baal and Astarut. But save us(excl) now from our(excl) enemies and we(excl) will_serve you(sg).’ 11 [xra][xrb][xrc][xrd]And the Lord sent Gideon,[fn] Barak, Hipta, and me. And we(excl) saved you(pl) from your(pl) enemies that surrounded you(pl). And now, you(pl) have_no fear in your(pl) living. 12 [xr]When you(pl) saw that you(pl) were invaded by Nahas the king of the descendants of Amun, you(pl) said to me, ‘We(excl) want a king to command us(excl),’ even though the Lord is your(pl) king.

13 “Ne kuntee seinid e ka Hari ne in-alam niyu. Imbuyu niyu sikandin wey imbehey e sikandin kaniyu te Magbebaye. 14 Keupianan niyu ke igkaaldek niyu ka Magbebaye, egpamakayen, wey egtumanen ka me suhu din, wey ke eg-ikulen niyu duma te Hari niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 15 Piru ke kene kew eg-ikul te Magbebaye, wey ke kene kew egtuman te me suhu din, eglegparan kew nikandin wey ka Hari niyu. 16 Purisu paheed-geed kew sasindeg wey pitawa niyu ka kein-inuwan ne eggimuwen te Magbebaye due te tangkaan niyu. 17 Tinggaani kuntee te trigu wey ware uran te seini ne timpu. Piru eg-umawen ku ka Magbebaye ne egpaluluhung wey egpeuran su eyew egkanengnengan niyu ke kamemu kareet ka neyimu niyu diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye pinaahi te pegbuyu niyu te Hari.”

13 “And now here is the king that you(pl) have_chosen. You(pl) requested him and the Lord gave him to_you(pl). 14 You(pl) will_prosper if you(pl) fear the Lord, serve (him), and obey his commands, and if you(pl) and your(pl) king follow the Lord your(pl) God. 15 But if you(pl) don't follow the Lord, and if you(pl) don't obey his commands, you(pl) and your(pl) king will_be_punished by_him. 16 Therefore continue(pl) standing and watch(pl) the miracles that the Lord will_do in front of you(pl). 17 It's harvest time now and there's_no rain at this time. But I will_call the Lord to cause_thunder and send_rain so_that you(pl) will_know the extent of the evil that you(pl) did in front of the Lord by_means of your(pl) requesting a king.”

18 Sikan naa, in-umew ni Samwil ka Magbebaye. Purisu migpaluluhung wey migpeuran ka Magbebaye te sika ne aldew wey nenaaldek-haldek ka langun ne etew te Magbebaye wey ki Samwil. 19 Ne ingkahiyan si Samwil te langun ne etew, “Ampu ka te Magbebaye nu para te me suluhuanen nu su eyew kene key egpamatey su intimulan ney ka sale ney pinaahi te pegbuyu ney te Hari.”

18 So then, Samwil called the Lord. Therefore the Lord caused_thunder and sent_rain on that day and all the people feared(pl) the Lord and Samwil. 19 And all the people said to Samwil, “Pray(sg) to the Lord your(sg) God for your(sg) servants so_that we(excl) won't die because we've(excl) added to (our) sin by our(excl) requesting a king.”

20 Ne migkahiyan ni Samwil ka keet-etawan, “Kene kew kaaldek. Minsan nekeyimu kew te sika ne sale, piru kene kew engked te Magbebaye, ke kene, pamakaya niyu sikandin te intiru ne pusung niyu. 21 Kene kew engked kandin tenged te ware karuan ne me diyus-diyus ne kene egpakabulig wey ke egpakaluwas naa kaniyu. 22 Su kene egsamsamilian te Magbebaye ka keet-etawan din su egkeyilawan ka mabantug ne ngaran din, su ingkahale din ka peggimu rin kaniyu ne keet-etawan din. 23 Kena a iya egsanggel ne eg-ampu para kaniyu, su ke kene ku seini eggimuwen, egpakasala a te Magbebaye. Sumsumana niyu ka me kein-inuwan ne inggimu rin para kaniyu. 25 Piru ke egpabulus kew ne eggimu te sale, egkengareetan kew iya lagkes ka Hari niyu.”

20 And Samwil said to the people, “Don't(pl) be_afraid. Even though you've(pl) done that sin, but don't(pl) leave the Lord, but rather, serve(pl) him with your(pl) entire heart(s). 21 Don't(pl) leave him since there's_no purpose to the false_gods that can't help or save you(pl). 22 Because the Lord won't reject his people due to his great name, XXX because he was_pleased in making you(pl) his people. 23 I won't stop praying for you(pl), because if I don't do this, I will_sin against the Lord.
