Ka pegdew-ey ni Samwil ki Saul

The scolding of Saul by Samwil

131 Tatelu ne pulu (30)[fn] ka idad ni Saul te timpu ne neyimu sikandin ne Hari te Israil wey mighari sikandin te hep-at ne pulu wey daruwa (42) ne leg-un.[fn] 2 Mig-alam si Saul te tatelu ne libu (3,000) ne etew ne me matig-Israil. Ka daruwa ne libu (2,000), induma rin diye te Mikmas wey diye te bubungan te Bitil. Ka senge-libu (1,000), imparuma rin ki Diyunatan diye te Gibiya ne sakup te Binhamin. Ne impeuli din e diye te tagse ugpaan dan ka duma ne me etew.

131 Saul's age was thirty (30)[fn] at the time when he became king of Israil and he reigned for forty-two (42) years.[fn] 2 Saul chose three thousand (3,000) people from_Israil. The two thousand (2,000) people, he accompanied to Mikmas and the mountain of Bitil. The one thousand (1,000), he sent with Diyunatan to Gibi in the jurisdiction of Binhamin. And he sent_home all the other people to their own residence(s).

3 Inlusuran ni Diyunatan ka kampu te me matig-Pilistiya diye te Giba wey narineg seini te duma ne me matig-Pilistiya. Purisu, migsuhu si Saul ne egparahingen ka me trumpita te intiru ne Israil eyew te peglibulung te me Hibruwanen te pegpakiggira. 4 Narineg te langun ne matig-Israil ne natalu ni Saul ka me matig-Pilistiya ne inlusuran din diye te kampu, ne egdumutan e sikandan te me matig-Pilistiya. Purisu, impeumew ka me sundalu eyew te peglibulung duma ki Saul diye te Gilgal.

3 Diyunatan invaded the camp of the (ones) from_Pilistiya at Gibi and those other from_Pilistiya heard (about) this. Therefore, Saul commanded that the trumpet be_sounded for entire Israil so_that the Hibruwanons could_prepare(pl) for war. 4 All the (ones) from_Israil heard that Saul defeated the (ones) from_Pilistiya that he attacked there to the camp, and the (ones) from_Pilistiya hated them. Therefore, the soldiers were_sent_for to gather with Saul at Gilgal.

5 Ne miglibulung ka me matig-Pilistiya eyew egpakiggira te Israil: due tatelu ne pulu ne libu (30,000)[fn] ne karwahi ran, wey hen-em ne libu (6,000) ne etew ne migmangudde wey due me sundalu ne egpekeiling kasalig te pantad diye te ilis te weyig. Ne miggendiyad e sikandan te Mikmas, diye te igsile te Bit-Abin, wey diye dan e migkekampu. 6 Te nakamaan-maan ka me matig-Israil te egkeenget-enget e sikandan su egkasegseg man-e sikandan te me kuntere dan, nangeles e sikandan diye te me sulung, diye te mabbenes, diye te me dalama, diye te me lungag, wey diye te me belun. 7 Ne miglapas e ka duma te Weyig ne Hurdan peendiye te Gad wey diye te Gilyad.

5 And the (ones) from_Pilistiya gathered to fight Israil: they had thirty thousand (30,000)[fn] carts, and six thousand (6,000) people riding_horses and there were soldiers like the plentifulness of sand at the edge of the water. And they went to Mikmas, there on the east of Bit-Abin, and they camped there. 6 When the (ones) from_Israil realized that they were getting crushed because their enemies were pressing_hard, they hid in caves, in the bushes, in cliffs, in holes, and in wells. 7 And others crossed(pl) the Jordan river going to Gad and to Gilyad. (NOTE it was the people going not the river)

Ne si Saul diye de mule te Gilgal wey migkelkel ka langun ne sundalu ne migduma kandin.8 [xr]Ne migtetahad si Saul te pitu ne aldew diye te Gilgal sumale te ingkerew ni Samwil kandin, piru ware miggendiye si Samwil. Puun due, bunsud e egmemekegsuwey-suwey ka me sundalu ni Saul. 9 Sikan naa ka migkahi e si Saul, “Uyana niyu kayi te keddi ka igpanubad ne egtutungen wey ka igpanubad para te keupianan.” Ne impanubad din e ka egtutungen ne igpanubad. 10 Te nekeimpus e si Saul ka egpanubad, miggingume e si Samwil, sikan naa ka miglihawang e si Saul eyew te peg-alumama kandin. 11 Ne mig-inse si Samwil, “Nekey-a ka inggimu nu?”

And Saul was just there at Gilgal and all the soldiers who accompanied him were shaking.8 [xr]And Saul waited there at Gilgal for seven days according to the schedule (LIT knots_made) by Samwil for_him, but Samwil didn't come. From that, the people of Saul began going_different_ways. 9 So then Saul said, “Bring(pl) the sacrifice to_be_burnt here to_me and the sacrifice for peace/prosperity.” And he sacrificed the burnt sacrifice. 10 When Saul had_finished sacrificing, Samwil arrived, so then Saul exited in_order to welcome him. 11 But Samwil said, “What have you(sg) done?”

Ne migtabak si Saul, “Te pegpitew ku ne egmemekegsuwey-suwey e ka me sundalu wey ware ka migginguma te kerew nu, wey nalibulung e ka me matig-Pilistiya diye te Mikmas,12 nakakahi a, ‘Eglusuran ad iya kuntee te me matig-Pilistiya kayi te Gilgal, ne ware e re due nakapangananey te Magbebaye ne Manama.’ Sikan naa ka napehes a ne egpanubad te egtutungen ne igpanubad.”

Saul answered, “When I saw that the soldiers were_going_different_ways and you(sg) didn't arrive on your(sg) schedule (LIT knots), and thosPilistiya e from_Pilistiya had gathered there at Mikmas,12 I said, ‘The (ones) from_Pilistiya will_ indeed _invade here at Gilga, and I haven't requested_help from the Lord God.’ So then I was forced/persuaded to sacrifice a burnt sacrifice.”

13 Ne migkahiyan ni Samwil si Saul, “Keungelan ka inggimu nu. Ware nu tumana ka insuhu keykew te Magbebaye nu. Ke intuman nu seeye, egpaharien din perem ka kabuhalan nu te ware egtamanan kayi te Israil. 14 [xr]Piru kenad e kuntee egpakabulus sika se peghari te kabuhalan nu. Egpamitew e ka Magbebaye te igkahale din ne etew ne igkeupii rin ne eghari te keet-etawan din, tenged su ware nu tumana ka suhu din.”

13 And Samwil said to Saul, “What_ you(sg) _did is foolish. You(sg) didn't obey what_ your(sg) Lord _commanded you(sg). 36 Ne migkahi si Saul, “Egtupangan ta te marusilem egpanalukuni ka me matig-Pilistiya wey eg-aminen ta sikandan egpangimatayi wey egpanguen ta ka langun ne kasangkapan dan taman te maselem.”

45 Piru ingkahiyan te keet-etawan si Saul, “Eggimatayan bes mule si Diyunatan ne iyan nekeyimu te dakel ne kapanaluwan te Israil? Kene egkaayun! Ka peghari ni Saul wey ka pamilya rin

The kinging by Saul and his family

47 Te timpu ne mighari si Saul te Israil, migpakiggira sikandin te langun ne kuntere din diye te lein-lein ne inged: diye te Muwab, diye te Amun, diye te inged te Idum, wey te me Hari diye te Suba wey te me matig-Pilistiya. 49 Ne ka me lukes ne anak ni Saul iyan si Diyunatan, si Isbi, wey si Malkisuwa. Ka pangulu te me sundalu ni Saul iyan si Abnir, ne anak te anggam din ne si Nir. 51 Ka amey ni Saul iyan si Kis; wey ka amey ni Abnir iyan si Nir, ne me anak ni Abiyil.

52 Taheed te neuyag pad si Saul, due masumpit ne egpabunbunuey ne me matig-Pilistiya wey me matig-Israil. Ne egsundaluwen ni Saul ke due egkakita rin ne manekal ne etew wey ke mabulut naa.

52 While Saul still lived, there_was fierce fighting_each_other of the (ones) from_Pilistiya and the (ones) from_Israil. And if Saul saw a strong or fierce person he made_(him)_a_soldier.

Ka pegdereet ni Saul te me Amalikanen

Ne miggun-a kandin ka talag-uyan te kalasag din. 8 Migsasindeg sikandin wey impanguleyian din ka me matig-Israil, “Mania te seini kew langun eyew te pegpakigbunu? Sabeka a ne matig-Pilistiya ne bahani wey sikaniyu me suluhuanen ni Saul. Alam kew te sabeka ne etew eyew egpabunbunuey key! 9 Ke egkeelehan a nikandin wey egkeyimatayan a nikandin, egkeyimu key e ne me suluhuanen niyu. Piru ke egkatalu ku sikandin wey egkapatey, egkeyimu kew e ne me suluhuanen ney wey egpamakey kanami.” 10 Ne migkahi si Gulayat, “Me sundalu te Israil, hentew kaniyu ka eg-atu keddiey? Ipeendini niyu ka sabeka ne etew su egpabun-bunuey key.” 11 Te pegkarineg dutu ni Saul wey te langun ne me matig-Israil, nangelkel e sikandan langun wey nenaaldek amana.

4 And there_was one person who exited from the camp of the (ones) from_Pilistiya named Gulayat from_Gat. He was skillful in fighting and his height (LIT length) was around three meters. 5 He wore bronze hilmit and there_was also bronze that protected his chest that was about fifty seven (57) kilograms in weight. 6 And he also clothed his shins with bronze and slung_over_(his)_shoulder a bronze sword. 7 His spear was heavy and thick, and the tip of it was iron and the weight was about seven kilograms. And the carrier of his shield preceded him. 8 He stood and he shouted at the (ones) from_Israil, “Why are you(pl) all here for fighting? I (am) a warrior from_Pilistiya and you(pl) (are) the servants of Saul. Choose(pl) one person in_order for us(excl) to fight each other! 9 If I will_be_defeated by him and I will_be_killed by_him, we(excl) will_become your(pl) servants. But if I defeat him and (he) dies, you(pl) will_become our(excl) servants and will_serve us(excl).” 10 And Gulayat said, “Soldiers of Israil, who of you(pl) can_fight me? Send_here(pl) one person for us(excl) to fight each other.” 11 When Saul and all the (ones) from_Israil heard this, all of them were trembled and very afraid.

Si Dabid wey si Gulayat

Dabid and Gulayat

12 Si Dabid, anak te matig-Iprata ne egngaranan ki Hisi ne diye mig-ugpe te Bitlihim ne sakup te Huda. Due walu ne me lukes ne me anak ni Hisi. Te peghari ni Saul, buyag e amana sikandin. 13 Ne migduma ki Saul ka tatelu ne kakey te me anak ni Hisi diye te bunuanan. Sikandan si Ilyab ka kinakakayan, si Abinadab ka igkarangeb, wey si Sama ka igkatelu. 14 Ne si Dabid ka kinaariyan. Ne ka tatelu ne kakey rin, egduma-ruma ki Saul te egpakiggira, 15 ne sikandin, eg-uli-uli de mule puun diye ki Saul su egtameng ma sikandin te me karniru te amey rin diye te Bitlihim.

12 Dabid, was a child of (one) from_Iprata named Hisi who lives there in Bitlihim under_the_jurisdiction of Judah. There were eight children of Hisi (who were) males. At the kinging by Saul, he was very old. 13 And three of the children of Hisi had accompanied Saul there to the fighting_place. They were Ilyab the oldest, Abinadab the next, and Sama the third. 14 And Dabid was the youngest. And while his three older_siblings, accompanied Saul to fight, 15 he, on_the_contrary would_ just _frequently_return_home from Saul because he watched_over the sheep of his father there in Bitlihim.

16 Ne inlelalisan ni Gulayat ka me matig-Israil te tagse aldew wey marusilem te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne aldew.

16 And Gulayat threatened the (ones) from_Israil each day and night for forty (40) days.

17 Ne ingkahiyan ni Hisi ka anak din ne si Dabid, “Kua nu seini se me liware te saku ne trigu ne insandag wey sapulu ne timman ne paan wey dagdahawi nu uyana diye te me suled nu diye te kampu. 18 Uyana nu degma diye te pangulu te sundalu seini se sapulu ne timman ne egkakeen ne egngaranan te kisu, wey pangemustaa nu degma ka peg-ugpe te me suled nu. Te peg-uli nu, uyan ka te minsan nekey ne egpamalehet ne meupiya red sikandan. 19 Diye kuntee te napu te Ila si Saul wey ka me suled nu, wey ka langun ne me matig-Israil, ka egpakigbunu te me matig-Pilistiya.”

17 And Hisi said to his child Dabid, “Take(sg) this half a sack of fruit/grain that's been_roasted and ten pieces of bread and take(sg)_it quickly to your(sg) siblings there at the camp. 18 Also take(sg) there to the leader of the soldiers these ten pieces of food named cheese (MS kisu from CEB keso), and also inquire_about the living of your(sg) siblings. On your(sg) returning_home, bring(sg) whatever that proves that they are (doing) good. 19 Saul and your(sg) siblings are there now/today on valley of Ila, and all the (ones) from_Israil, the (ones) fighting the (ones) from_Pilistiya.”

20 Purisu te seup ne aldew, migselem-selem mig-enew si Dabid wey inggaat din ka me karniru diye te sabeka ne talagtameng, wey miggipanew e sikandin ne in-uyan din ka egkakeen sumale te insuhu ni Hisi kandin. Te pegginguma rin diye te kampu te me matig-Israil, egligwang e ka me sundalu ne migmanguleyi eyew egpakiggira. 21 Ne migpatangkeey e ka me matig-Israil wey ka me matig-Pilistiya ne andam e ne egpabunbunuey. 22 Ne inggaat ni Dabid ka inuyanan din diye te talagtameng te me kasangkapan wey migpallahuy diye te migluyud ne me sundalu eyew te pegpangemusta te me suled din. 23 Taheed te migpakiglalag pad sikandin kandan, mig-awe e mule puun te punduk te me sundalu si Gulayat, ka Pilistihanen ne mangngateu ne egpakiggira te matig-Gat wey inlelalisan din e man-e ka me matig-Israil, wey narineg seeye ni Dabid. 24 Te pegkakita te me matig-Israil ki Gulayat, amana sikandan nenaaldek wey namallahuy e. 25 Ne migmalalahey sikandan ne miggenendue, “Nakita niyu sika se etew ne egpatakereg? Migtakereg iya sikandin eyew te peglelalis te me matig-Israil. Ne egbehayan te Hari te dakel ne karatuan ka seeye se egpakapatey kandin wey igpaasawa rin pad kandin ka anak din ne malitan. Ne kene pad iya man-e egpabayaren te buhis te Israil ka pamilya te amey rin.”

20 Therefore on the next day, Dabid rose early and he left the sheep with a (LIT one) watcher, and he went according to what_ Hisi _had_commanded him. On his arrival at the camp of the (ones) from_Israil, the soldiers exited shouting(pl) in_order to fight. 21 And the (ones) from_Israil and the (ones) from_Pilistiya faced_each_other ready to fight_each_other. 22 And Dabid left what_ he _brought there with the guard of the equipment and ran there to the soldiers standing_beside_(each_other) in_order to greet his siblings. 23 While he was still talking with them, Gulayat, the Pilistihanon who was skillful in fighting from_Gat exited on_the_contrary from the group of soldiers and he threatened the (ones) from_Israil again, and Dabid heard this. 24 When the (ones) from_Israil heard Gulayat, they were_ very _afraid(pl) and fled(pl). 25 And they said_to_each_other going, “Have you(pl) seen that person ascending? He indeed ascends in_order to threaten the (ones) from_Israil. And the king will_give great riches to that (person) who can kill him and (the king) will_give_in_marriage to him his female child. And the family of his father won't have to pay taxes to Israil yet.”

26 Ne mig-inse si Dabid te etew ne diye te marani rin, “Nekey-a ka igdasag te seeye se etew ne egpakapatey te sika ne matig-Pilistiya wey egpakaluwas te Israil puun te pegkeyilew? Hentew-a sika se matig-Pilistiya ne ware migpalintutuu te Manama[fn] ne miglelalis te me sundalu te manekal ne Manama?” 27 Ne innangenan sikandin te me etew meyitenged te dasag ne egkarawat te seeye se etew ne egpakapatey ki Gulayat.

26 And Dabid asked the person who was close to him, “What is the reward for that person who can_kill that Pilistihanon and can_save Israil from shame? Who is that Pilistihanon who doesn't believe in God[fn] that challenges the soldiers of the living/strong God?” 27 And he was_informed by the people concerning the reward that would_be_received by that person who could_kill Gulayat.

28 Ne nabelu amana si Ilyab, ka kinakakayan ne suled ni Dabid te pegkarineg te migpakiglalag sikandin te me etew. Ne migkahiyan din si Dabid, “Mania te miggendini ka? Hentew-a ka inggaatan nu te pila-pila ne karniru ta diye te disirtu? Nakanengneng a te pegkaambug nu, wey te kareet te suman-suman nu. Miggendini ke re eyew te pegpitew te gira.”

28 And Ilyab, the eldest sibling of Dabid was_ very _angry at hearing what_ he _was_saying with the people. And he told Dabid, “Why did you(sg) come_here? Who did you(sg) leave the few sheep with in the desert? I know about your(sg) pride, and the evil of your(sg) thinking. You(sg) just came_here for seeing the war.”

29 Migkahi si Dabid, “Nekey-a ka neyimu ku ne mareet? Mig-inse e man de!” 30 Mig-inniyug si Dabid wey mig-inse e man-e sikandin diye te lein ne me etew te sikan ded ne inse wey iling ded te hun-a ne tabak ka intabak te me etew kandin.

29 Dabid said, “What have I done wrong? I just asked!” 30 Dabid turned and he asked other persons again that same question and the answer of the persons to him was_ just _like the first answer.

31 Te pegkarineg te me etew te ingkahi ni Dabid, innangen dan e seini ki Saul wey impakuwe e ni Saul si Dabid. 32 Ingkahiyan ni Dabid si Saul, “Ware sabeka kanta ne eleg ne egkaliyasan te sika ne matig-Pilistiya. Sikeddi se suluhuanen nu, egpakig-ehet kandin.”

31 When the people heard what_ Dabid _was_saying, they told it to Saul and Saul sent_for Dabid. 32 Saul was_told by Dabid, “There's_not one of us(incl) that should be_afraid of the Pilistihanon. I your(sg) servant, will_fight him.”

33 Ne migtabak si Saul, “Kene ke pad ne eleg ne egpakig-ehet te sika ne matig-Pilistiya su egkankanakan ke pad wey bahani e mule sikandin bunsud pad te pegkabate din.”

33 And Saul answered, “You(sg) are_ not _fitting to fight that Pilistihanon because you(sg) are still youth and he on_the_contrary has been a warrior from his youth.”

34 Piru migtabak si Dabid, “Nakapaney a ne talagtameng te me karniru te amey ku. Ke due liyun wey ke usu naa ne egdawi te nati ne karniru puun te punduk, 35 eglupuhen ku seeye wey eglampesan, wey eg-ahawen ku ka karniru ne imbange din. Ke egbaliyung seini keddi, eggen-genan ku ka sumpe din, eglampesan, wey eggimatayan ku. 36 Nakapatey a te liyun wey te usu, ne sika se matig-Pilistiya ne ware migpalintutu te Manama[fn] egpekeiling te seeye se nangimatayan ku tenged su inhanggat din ma ka me sundalu te manekal ne Manama.” 37 Ne migpabulus si Dabid ka miglalag, “Inluwas a te Magbebaye puun te liyun wey te usu, purisu egluwasen e red degma nikandin puun te sika ne matig-Pilistiya.”

34 But Dabid answered, “I used to watch the sheep of my father. If there's a lion or a bear that preys_on a young sheep from the group, 35 I would pursue it and beat_it, and I would snatch the sheep that it's held_in_(its)_mouth. If it spins on me, I would_grab its jaw, would_beat (it), and I would_kill_it. 36 I have_killed lion and bear, and that Pilistihanon who doesn't believe (in) God[fn] is_ just _like those that I killed(pl) because he challenged the soldiers of the living/strong God.” 37 And Dabid continued to speak, “I was_saved by the Lord from a lion and a bear, therefore I'll also be_saved by_him from that (person) from_Pilistiya.”

Ne ingkahiyan ni Saul si Dabid, “Ne ayun kad iya ka egpakig-ehet kandin wey egdumaan ka te Magbebaye!”38 Ne impakukumbale ni Saul si Dabid te kumbale din te egpakiggira wey impasaluub din sikandin te hilmit ne burunsi, wey impaagpiyan din te burunsi ka kumeng din. 39 Insiniket ni Dabid ka kampilan ni Saul wey mig-eleg-eleg miggipanew piru egkewuyut sikandin tenged su ware sikandin nalayam kayi, sikan naa ka ingkahiyan din si Saul, “Egkewuyut a ke egsaluub a kayi su wara a nalayam.” Purisu inluung ni Dabid seeye. 40 Ne ingkuwa rin ka tuked din wey mig-alam sikandin te lalimma ne batu ne mallurung diye te bangalug wey intahu din diye te puyungut din te egtameng te karniru. Ne migparani si Dabid ki Gulayat ne mig-uyan te lambuyug.

And Dabid was_told by Saul, “Ok_then continue(sg) on to fight him and the Lord will_accompany you(sg)!”38 And Saul had_ Dabid _dressed in his clothing for fighting and had_ him _wear a bronze hilmit, and had_ his chest _covered with bronze. 39 Dabid belted_(himself) with the sword of Saul and tried to walk but he was uncomfortable_with luggage because he wasn't used to this, so then he told Saul, “I am uncomfortable if I dress like this in fighting because I'm not used to (it).” Therefore Dabid took_ them _off. 40 And he got his staff and he chose five smooth stones from the brook and he put these in his cloth_bag from watching the sheep. And Dabid approached Gulayat carrying slingshot.

Ka pegpabunuey ni Dabid wey Gulayat

The fighting_together of Dabid and Gulayat

41 Ne migsinug-ung degma ki Dabid si Gulayat ne miggun-a kandin ka talag-uyan te me kalasag din. 42 Te namelmelehan e ni Gulayat si Dabid, inlemetan din e sikandin tenged su egkankanakan mem pad sikandin wey malalab-lalab ka beneng, wey mateles sikandin ne egpitawen. 43 Ne ingkahiyan din si Dabid, “Mania, asu a su eg-uyan ke re te tuked ka egparani keddi?” Ne indilus din e si Dabid pinaahi te me manama rin. 44 Migkahi sikandin, “Dani ka keddi su igpakeen ku te me manuk-manuk wey te me mahintalunan ka sapu nu.”

41 And Gulayat also came_to_meet Dabid and the carrier of his shield preceded him. 42 When Gulayat clearly_saw Dabid, he mocked him since he was still youth and (his) cheek(s) were reddish, and he (was) good to_look_at. 43 And he said to Dabid, “Why, am I a dog that you(sg) just bring a staff to approach me?” And he cursed Dabid by_means of his gods. 44 He said, “Approach(sg) me because I'll feed your(sg) flesh to the birds and the wild_animals.”

45 Ne ingkahiyan ni Dabid si Gulayat, “Migdani ka keddi ne mig-uyan te kampilan, deldeg, wey pungyal piru migdani a keykew pinaahi te ngaran te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, ne iyan ka Manama te me sundalu te Israil ne inlemetan nu. 46 Te seini ne aldew igbehey ka te Magbebaye keddi. Eggimatayan ku sikeykew wey egtempuhen ku ka lieg nu. Igpakeen ku te me manuk-manuk wey te me mahintalunan ne mananap ka nammatey ne me sundalu ne matig-Pilistiya eyew egkanengnengan te intiru ne kalibutan ne due Manama te Israil. 47 Ne egpakanengneng ka langun ne miglibulung kayi te egpangabang ka Magbebaye te me etew rin; kene ne pinaahi te kampilan wey te deldeg, su iyan egpakig-ehet ka Manama wey igpareeg kew nikandin kanami.”

45 And Dabid said to Gulayat, “You(sg) approach me bringing a sword, spear, and knife but I approach you(sg) by_means of the name of the Very Strong Lord, who is the God of the soldiers of Israil that you(sg) have mocked. 46 On this day the Lord will_give you(sg) to_me. I will_kill you(sg) and I will_cut_off_at your(sg) neck. I will_feed the slaughtered Pilistihanon soldiers to the birds and the wild animals so_that the entire world will_know that there_is a God of Israil. 47 And everyone who has gathered here will_know that the Lord helps his people; not by means_of the sword or spear, because it's God who will_fight and you(pl) caused_to_be_defeated by us(excl).”

48 Taheed te egparani e si Gulayat ki Dabid eyew egbunu kandin, migsinug-ung e degma si Dabid peendiye ki Gulayat eyew te pegpakig-ehet degma kandin. 49 Migsikep si Dabid te batu diye te puyungut din wey imbala rin e te lambuyug din, ne intileng din e seini, wey impatummawan din ka buked ni Gulayat. Ne nakalebeng ka batu diye te buked din wey napeled e sikandin ne nakalangkeb diye te tane. 50 [xr]Purisu, natalu ni Dabid si Gulayat pinaahi re te lambuyug wey te batu. Napatey ni Dabid si Gulayat minsan ware kampilan din. 51 [xr]Ne migpallahuy si Dabid peendiye ki Gulayat wey migsasindeg diye te andang din. Ne inggulabut din e ka kampilan ni Gulayat wey innimatayan din e sikandin, wey intempug e ka ulu.

48 While Gulayat approached Dabid in_order to fight him, Dabid also came_to_meet Gulayat in_order to fight him also. 49 Dabid extracted a stone from his cloth_bag and loaded his slingshot, and he spun it, and he shot Gulayat's forehead. And the stone sunk_into his forehead and he fell_over lying_face_down there on the ground. 50 [xr]Therefore, Dabid defeated Gulayat just by_means of slingshot and one stone. Dabid killed Gulayat even though he didn't have a sword. 51 [xr]And Dabid ran towards Gulayat and stood next to him. And he unsheathed the sword of Gulayat and he killed him, and chopped_off the head.

Te pegkakita te me matig-Pilistiya te namatey e ka mangngateu ran ne egpakiggira, namallahuy e sikandan.52 Ne migmanguleyi ka me matig-Israil wey Huda, wey inlupug dan ka me matig-Pilistiya puun te Gat taman te kasunguwan te Ikrun. Natalagtag ka migpatey ne me matig-Pilistiya puun te dalan peendiye te Saraim taman te Gat wey Ikrun. 53 Te nekeimpus e sikandan ka eglupug te me matig-Pilistiya, migmanlibed e sikandan wey impanguwa ran e ka me kasangkapan te me matig-Pilistiya ne neneengkeran diye te kampu. 54 Ne ingkuwa ni Dabid ka ulu ni Gulayat wey in-uyan din seini diye te Hirusalim, piru diye din itahu te balungbalung din ka kasangkapan ni Gulayat.

When the (ones) from_Pilistiya saw that their skillful_in_fighting was dead, they fled(pl).52 And the (ones) from_Israil and Judah shouted(pl), and they pursued the (ones) from_Pilistiya from Gat until the beginning of Ikrun. Those slaughtered from_Pilistiya were_spread_out from the path going to Saraim until Gat and Ikrun. 53 When they had_finished pursuing the (ones) from_Pilistiya, they returned(pl) and they got(pl) the equipment of the (ones) from_Pilistiya that was discarded(pl) there in the camp. 54 And Dabid took the head of Gulayat and he brought it to Hirusalim, but he put the equipment of Gulayat into a tent.

Ka peg-inse-inse ni Saul ki Dabid

The questioning of Dabid by Saul

55 Te pegkakita ni Saul ki Dabid te migparani ki Gulayat, in-insaan din e si Abnir, ka pangulu te me sundalu te miggenendue, “Abnir, hentew-a anak te sika ne kanakan?”

55 When Saul had_seen Dabid approaching Gulayat, he questioned Abnir, the leader of the soldiers going, “Abnir, whose child is that young_man?”

Ne migtabak si Abnir, “Mahal ne Hari, egpahunlibet a te umul nu, wara a nakanengneng.”

And Abnir replied, “Honored king, I swear by your(sg) life, I don't know.”

56 Ne migkahi ka Hari, “Nengnengi nu ke hentew anak te sika ne kanakan.”

56 And the king said, “Find_out(sg) whose child that young_man is.”

57 Te nekeuli e si Dabid puun te peggimatey ki Gulayat, indume e sikandin ni Abnir diye ki Saul. Ne in-uyan-uyan de due ni Dabid ka ulu ni Gulayat. 58 Ne mig-insaan sikandin ni Saul, “Tatu, hentew-a ka amey nu?”

57 When Dabid returned from killing Gulayat, Abnir accompanied him to Saul. And Dabid was still carrying the head of Gulayat. 58 And he was_questioned by Saul, “Boy, who is your(sg) father?”

Ne migtabak si Dabid, “Anak a te suluhuanen nu ne si Hisi ne matig-Bitlihim.”

And Dabid answered, “I'm a/the child of your(sg) servant Hisi from_Bitlihim.”

Ka pegpaalukuyey ni Dabid wey ni Diyunatan

The friending of Dabid and Diyunatan

181 Te nekeimpus e si Dabid ka egpakiglalag ki Saul, nekeg-alukuy e amana sikandan ki Diyunatan. Indakelan ni Diyunatan te geyinawa si Dabid ne alukuy rin iling te peggeyinawa rin te pegkeetew rin. 2 Bunsud te seeye ne aldew, diyad e peugpaa ni Saul te kandin si Dabid, wey ware din e tuhuti ne eg-uli diye te baley te amey rin. 3 Ne migpakigsabut si Diyunatan ki Dabid ne egpeunungey sikandan taman te katamanan su indakelan din ma sikandin te geyinawa iling te pegkeetew rin. 4 Ne inluung e ni Diyunatan ka mateles ne diyakit din ne malayat wey imbehey rin e seini ki Dabid, lagkes ka me kumbale din, duma te kampilan din, pane, wey libed. 5 Migpanpanalu si Dabid te langun ne impalusuran kandin ni Saul, sikan naa ka inggimu e sikandin ni Saul ne sabeka ne pangulu te me sundalu. Nakapahale seini te langun ne etew wey te me upisyal ni Saul.

181 When Dabid finished speaking with Saul, he and Diyunatan greatly befriended_each_other. Dabid was greatly_loved by Diyunatan as he loved himself. 2 Beginning on that day, Saul had_ Dabid _live with him, and he wasn't allowed to return_home to the house of his father. 3 And Diyunatan and Dabid agreed_with_each_other that they would_be inseparable until the end because he greatly_loved him as himself. 4 And Diyunatan took_off his long clothing/shirt and he gave this to Dabid, including his clothing/shirts, along_with his sword, bow, and belt. 5 Dabid repeatedly_won of all that Saul asked_him_to_attack, so_that Saul made him one leader of soldiers. This pleased all the people and the officials of Saul.

Ka pegkasekel ni Saul ki Dabid

Saul is envious of Dabid

6 Pegkapenga neyimatayi ni Dabid si Gulayat, nanguli e ka me etew. Ne insinug-ung si Saul te me malitan ne namuun te me siyudad te Israil ne memaggale-gale ne nangulahing wey migmanesayew ne egbalesen te me tamburin wey te me alpa. 7 [xr]Ne mig-ulahing sikandan te peggale-gale dan ne miggenendue,

6 After Dabid killed Gulayat, the people went_home. And Saul met_on_the_road by the women from the cities of Israil that were happily singing(pl) and dancing(pl) swaying with the tambourines and harps. 7 [xr]And they sang happily going,

“Eglibu-libu ka neyimatayan ni Saul,

“Saul killed about thousands,

piru egsapulu ne libu mule ka neyimatayan ni Dabid.”

but Dabid on_the_contrary killed about ten thousands.”

8 Ne nabelu-belu si Saul tenged su ka seeye ne lalag ware nakapahale kandin. Ne migkahi sikandin, “Mania te migkahi sikandan te tigsapulu ne libu ka napatey ni Dabid, piru libu-libu re ka neyimatayan ku? Ne egkataman, eggimuwen dan e sikandin ne Hari.” 9 Ne puun te seeye ne aldew, eg-iipaten e ni Saul si Dabid tenged su nasekel sikandin kandin.

8 And Saul was angry because these words didn't please him. And he said, “Why do they say that tens of thousands were_killed by Dabid, but that I just killed thousands? Afterwards, they would_make him king.” 9 And from that day, Saul monitored Dabid because he was envious of him.

10 Te seup ne aldew, in-umaan si Saul te mareet ne panisingan ne impeuyan te Manama, wey migpangasak sikandin diye te seled te baley rin ne hendue te egbusawen. Ne dutu, migpangelit e te alpa si Dabid sumale te ingkalayami rin ne eggimuwen. Ne miggen-gen si Saul te deldeg 11 wey impilak din e si Dabid te migkahi diye te suman-suman din, “Igpakpak ku si Dabid diye te alabat.” Ne kararuwa pilaka ni Saul si Dabid, piru nakalikay sikandin.

10 The next day, an evil spirit came to Saul that was_sent by God, and he lectured there in his house as_if crazy. And then, Dabid strummed_the_harp as he was accustomed to do. And Saul held a spear 11 and he threw_the_spear at Dabid while saying in his thinking, “I'll nail Dabid to the wall.” And Saul speared Dabid twice, but he avoided (it).

12 Ne migduma ka Magbebaye ne Manama ki Dabid, wey warad e sikandin migduma ki Saul. Purisu, naaldek si Saul ki Dabid. 13 Sikan naa ka impaawe e ni Saul si Dabid diye te tangkaan din wey inggimu rin e ne pangulu te senge-libu ne me sundalu. 20 But Abiyatar, one child of Ahimilik the child of Ahitub fled, and went to Dabid. 21 And he told Dabid that Saul had killed the sacrificers of the Lord. 22 And Dabid said to Abiyatar, “I knew that Duig would inform Saul, because he was there at the giving by Ahimilik of the sword of Gulayat to me. Ka pegluwas ni Dabid te Lungsud te Kiila

6 Ne due ipud ne in-uyan te anak ni Ahimilik ne si Abiyatar te pegpallahuy rin puun ki Saul peendiye ki Dabid diye te Kiila.

9 Te pegkanengnengi ni Dabid te migplanu si Saul te pegdereet kandin, migkahiyan din e si Abiyatar, ka talagpanubad, “Uyana nu kayi ka ipud.” 10 Ne migkahi si Dabid, “Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil, nakarineg a iya se suluhuanen nu te eggendini si Saul te Kiila eyew te pegdereet te seini ne lungsud tenged keddiey. 11 Igbehey e naa te me matig-Kiila diye ki Saul? 9 When Dabid knew that Saul planned on destroying him, he said to Abiyatar, the sacrificer, “Bring(sg) the ephod here.” 10 And Dabid said, “Lord God of Israil, I your(sg) servant have heard that Saul is_coming here to Kiila for destroying this town due to me. 11 Will I be given by the (ones) from_Kiila to Saul? 13 Therefore Dabid and his six hundred (600) people left Kiila and went_around to wherever. On the hearing of Saul that Dabid had fled from Kiila, he didn't continue there.

Ka peglupug ni Saul ki Dabid

The pursuing of Dabid by Saul

14 Ne miggeles si Dabid diye te me helesanan diye te disirtu ne diye te bubungan te Sip. Ne impamitew ni Saul si Dabid te tagse aldew, piru ware sikandin ipakita te Manama ki Saul. 15 Taheed te diye si Dabid te Huris diye te disirtu te Sip, nakarineg sikandin ne egpammitawen sikandin ni Saul eyew eggimatayan. 16 Ne miggendiye si Diyunatan ki Dabid diye te Huris eyew te pegbagget kandin te pegsalig te Manama. 17 Migkahi si Diyunatan, “Kene ka kaaldek su kene ka nikandin egkakita wey kene ka nikandin egkamenu. 21 Saul said, “You(pl) will_be_blessed by the Lord due to your(pl) concern for_me. 22 So_then, go(pl) and carefully(pl) look where he is hiding. Find_out(pl) where he goes_back_and_forth and who sees him there. 24 Purisu miggun-e e sikandan ki Saul diye te Sip. Te seeye ne timpu, diyad e si Dabid wey ka me etew rin te disirtu diye te Maun ne diye te Araba, dapit te igkakawanan ne balabahan te Hisimun. 25 Ne miggendiyad si Saul wey ka me etew rin eyew te pegpamitew ki Dabid. Ware himatayi ni Dabid si Saul

241 Te peg-uli ni Saul te migpakiggira te me matig-Pilistiya, due nakanangen kandin ne diye si Dabid te disirtu diye te In-Gidi. 2 Purisu mig-alam si Saul te tatelu ne libu (3,000) ne me etew puun te intiru ne Israil wey miggipanew e ka egpamitew ki Dabid wey te me etew rin. Miggendiye sikandan te inged ne marani te dalama ne in-ugpaan te leew ne me kambing. 3 [xr]Ne nekeuma si Saul diye te alad te karniru ne diye te ilis te dalan, wey due sulung dutu. 241 When Saul returned_home from warring the (ones) from_Pilistiya, there_was (someone who) informed him that Dabid was in the desert at In-Gidi. 2 Therefore Saul chose three thousand (3,000) people from entire Israil and went to find Dabid and his people. And then he entered it in_order to defecate but [surprise] on_the_contrary in the inner_most Dabid and his followers were hiding. 4 Dabid was_told by his people, “This indeed is the time that the Lord God spoke_about to_you(sg), ‘I will_ indeed _give your(sg) enemy to you(sg) and do(sg) whatever you(sg) want to him.’ ” And Dabid approached to Saul carefully and sawed_off the tip of the clothing of Saul. And Saul didn't feel it. 5 But when this finished, Dabid regretted because he had sawn_off the tip of the clothing of Saul. 6 [xr]And he told his people, “The Lord God will_ not _allow that my master will_suffer to me because he chose him as king.” 7 And he scolded his people by_means of those words and he didn't allow them to kill Saul.

Ne migsasindeg si Saul wey migligwang e diye te sulung wey migpabulus e ka miggipanew.8 Ne migligwang e degma si Dabid diye te sulung wey in-umew rin si Saul te miggenendue, “Mahal ne Hari!” Te peglilingey ni Saul, miglangkeb e si Dabid diye te tane eyew te pegtahud kandin. 9 Ne migkahiyan ni Dabid si Saul, “Mania te migpalintutuu ka te me etew ne migkahi ne egkeupian e kun ne egdereet keykew? 10 Kuntee ne aldew egkanengnengan nu ke immenu ka te Magbebaye te pegbehey keddi diye te seled te sulung. Imbagget a te duma ne eggimatayan ka piru ware ku sikeykew himatayi. Migkahiyan ku sikandan te kene ku egdereetan ka ahalen ku tenged su in-alam sikandin ne Hari te Magbebaye. 11 Ame, pitawa nu ke nekey seini se inggen-genan ku. Baad seini te kumbale nu ne impisang ku. Napisang ku ka pupul te kumbale nu piru ware ku himatayi sikeykew. Sika ka egpamalehet ne ware tuyu ku ne pegdereet keykew wey ware mareet ne neyimu ku. Wara a nakasale keykew piru migpanalukunan a nikeykew eyew eggimatayan. 12 Meupiya ne ka Magbebaye iyan eggukum kanta te daruwa wey ka egsuli keykew te mareet ne inggimu nu keddi, piru kene ku iya sikeykew egdereetan. 13 Su egkahi rengan ka me kabuybuyahan, ‘Ka mareet de ne etew ka eggimu te mareet,’ sikan naa ka kene ku egdereetan sikeykew. 14 [xr]Etuwey naan de iya keykew Hari te Israil te egpanlupug keddi, hentew e bes seini se eglupuhen nu? Iling ke re te migpanlupug te migpatey e ne asu wey ke sisip naa. 15 Meupiya ne iyan eggukum ka Magbebaye ne Manama ke hentew kanta te daruwa ka due sale wey eleg ne egparusaan. Meupiya perem ne egpamminehen a nikandin, egpangabangan, wey egbulihan ne kene egsahap keykew.

And Saul stood and exited from the cave and continued going.8 And Dabid also exited the cave and he called Saul going, “Honored king!” When Saul turned, Dabid lay_face_down on the ground in_order for respecting him. 9 And Dabid said to Saul, “Why do you(sg) believe the people who say that I want [reportedly] to destroy you(sg)? 10 This day you(sg) can_know how the Lord gave you(sg) to_me there inside the cave. Si Dabid, si Nabal, wey si Abigil

Dabid, Nabal, and Abigail

251 Nataman, migpatey e si Samwil wey miglibulung ka langun ne matig-Israil, wey miglungku sikandan tenged kandin. Inlebeng dan sikandin diye te ugpaan din diye te Rama.

251 Then, Samwil died and all the (ones) from_Israil gathered, and they mourned for him. They buried him there at his residence at Rama.

Te neimpusan e seini, migtupang e si Dabid te disirtu diye te Paran.2 Due sabeka ne etew diye te Maun ne amana ne meyaman wey due tane din diye te Karmil. Due tatelu ne libu (3,000) ne karniru rin wey sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne kambing. Ne impangalutan din ka me karniru rin diye te Karmil. 3 Si Nabal ka ngaran te etew wey si Abigil ka ngaran te asawa rin. Malayat se suman-suman ni Abigil wey mateles sikandin ne malitan piru mahaan mule egkabelu ka lukes wey mareet se batasan. Kabuhalan sikandin ni Kalib.

When this was_finished, Dabid went_down to the desert there at Paran.2 There was one person there at Maun who was very rich and he had land at Karmil. He had three thousand (3,000) sheep and one thousand (1,000) goats. And he was shearing his sheep there at Karmil. 3 Nabal was the name of the person and Abigil was the name of his spouse. Abigil has great_wisdom (LIT long thinking) and she was beautiful woman but the male got angry quickly and (his) custom was bad. He was a descendant of Kalib.

4 Taheed te diye si Dabid te disirtu, nakarineg sikandin ne migpangalut si Nabal te me karniru rin. 5 Sikan naa ka migsuhu si Dabid te sapulu ne me lukes-lukes wey ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Hendiye kew ki Nabal diye te Karmil wey ipangemuste e naa nikaniyu. 6 Kahii niyu sikandin, ‘Ka keupianan egduma keykew peendiye te pamilya nu wey te langun ne keykew. 7 Nakarineg a te impepangalutan nu ka me karniru nu. 9 Purisu te pegginguma te me etew ni Dabid diye ki Nabal, inlalag dan e kandin ka lalag ni Dabid. And Dabid went_on_his_journey and Saul also returned_home.

Ka peg-aput ni Dabid diye te me matig-Pilistiya

The evacuating of Dabid to the (ones) from_Pilistiya

271 Nakakahi si Dabid diye te suman-suman din, “Egginguma ka timpu ne egkeyimatayan a ni Saul. Iyan meupiya ne eggimuwen ku se egpallahuy diye te me matig-Pilistiya eyew egpeeneng-eneng e si Saul ka egpamitew keddi kayi te intiru ne Israil. Ne egpakapariyu ad kandin.” 2 Sikan naa ka miggipanew e si Dabid duma te hen-em ne gatus (600) ne etew rin wey miggendiyad e ki Akis ne Hari te Gat wey anak ni Mauk. 3 Ne diyad e sikandan mig-ugpe te Gat duma ki Hari Akis. Induma te tagse sabeka ka me pamilya ran wey induma degma ni Dabid ka daruwa ne duwey rin ne si Ahinuwam ne matig-Hisriil wey si Abigil ne matig-Karmil ne balu ni Nabal. 4 Te nahuhuran e si Saul te migpallahuy e si Dabid diye te Gat, ware din e sikandin pamitawa.

271 Dabid said to his thoughts, “The time will_come that I'll be_killed by Saul. The good (thing) for me to do is to flee to the (ones) from_Pilistiya so_that Saul will_cease from searching for me here in entire Israil. And I will_be_able_to_be_distant from him.” 2 So then Dabid along_with his six hundred (600) people and went_there to Akis the king of Gat and child of Mauk. 3 And there they lived there in Gat along_with King Akis. Each one was accompanied by their family and Dabid took_along his two junior_wives who were Ahinuwam from_Hisriil and Abigil from_Karmil the widow of Nabal. 4 When Saul was_storied that Dabid had fled to Gat, he didn't search_for him.

5 Sabeka ne aldew, ingkahiyan ni Dabid si Akis, “Ke ingkahale e red ubag nikeykew, behayi key te sabeka ne lungsud kayi te nasud nu ne egkeugpaan ney su kene key ne likes ne kayi eg-ugpe te siyudad ne in-ugpaan nu, Mahal ne Hari.” 6 Purisu te seeye ne aldew, imbehey e ni Akis ki Dabid ka Siklag. Puun dutu, iyan e kamuney te Siklag ka me Hari te Huda taman kuntee. 7 Ne mig-ugpe si Dabid diye te inged te me matig-Pilistiya te sabeka ne leg-un wey hep-at ne bulan.

5 One day, Akis was_told by Dabid, “If I make_ you(sg) _happy, give us(excl) one town here in your(sg) country that we(excl) can_live in because we(excl) (are) not worthy to live here in the city that is your(sg) residence, Beloved king.” 6 Therefore on that day, Akis gave Siklag to Dabid. From then, the owner of Siklag has been the kings of Judah until now. 7 And Dabid lived in the place of the (ones) from_Pilistiya for one year and four months.

8 Taheed te mig-uugpe si Dabid wey ka me etew rin diye, migpanlusuran dan ka me Gisurihanen, ka me Girsihanen, wey ka me Amalikanen. Bunsud pad dengan, diyad nangugpe ka sika ne me etew te inged ne marani te Sur peendiye te Ihiptu. 9 Tagse eglusud ensi Dabid te sabeka ne inged, egguleen dan iya te egpangimatey ka me lukes wey me malitan. Ne egpanguen dan e ka me karniru, baka, asnu, kamil, wey me kumbale. Ne egkataman, eglibed e sikandan diye ki Hari Akis. 10 Ke eg-insaan ni Akis si Dabid, “Hendei kew migpanlusud kuntee?” Ne egtabak sikandin, “Diye te inged te Nigib ne due matig-Huda,” wey ke, “diye te inged te Nigib ne in-ugpaan te me Hiramilhanen” wey ke “diye te me Kinihanen.” 11 Egpangimatayan iya enni Dabid ka langun ne me lukes wey me malitan su eyew ware egpekeendiye te Gat ne egpakanangen ke nekey ka inggimu rin. Seini ka layun eggimuwa ni Dabid te timpu ne diye sikandin mig-ugpe te inged te me matig-Pilistiya. 12 Amana ne migsalig si Akis ki Dabid wey migkahi diye te suman-suman din, “Indumutan en iya kuntee si Dabid te keet-etawan te Israil, puun due, egkeyimu kud sikandin ne suluhuanen taman te ware egtamanan.”

8 While Dabid and his men lived there, they invaded(pl) the Gisurihanons, the Girsihanons, and the Amalikanons. Beginning before, that people lived in the place near Sur toward Ihiptu. 9 Each invading by Dabid and_company of one place, they exterminated indeed killing males and females. And they took(pl) the sheep, cows, donkeys, camels, and clothing. And then, they returned there to King Akis. 10 If Dabid was_asked by Akis, “Where did you(pl) invade today?” And he would answer, “There in place of Nigib that have (people) from_Huda,” or “there in the place of Negib where Hiramilhanons” or, “there in the Kinihanons.” 11 Dabid and_company indeed killed all males and females so_that there_was none (who) could_go_there to Gat to inform what_ he _had_done. Dabid always did this at the time that he lived there in the place of the (ones) from_Pilistiya. 12 Akis greatly trusted Dabid and said to his thoughts, “Dabid is really hated now by the people of Israil, from that, he will_become my servant until without ending.”

Ka pegpakiglalag ni Saul te gimukud ni Samwil

The talking_together of Saul and the soul of Samwil

281 Te seeye ne timpu, inlibulung te me matig-Pilistiya ka me sundalu ran eyew egpakiggira te Israil. Ne migkahiyan ni Hari Akis si Dabid, “Keilangan ne egkanengnengan nu ne sikeykew wey ka me etew nu, egduma iya te egpakiggira.”

281 At that time, the (ones) from_Pilistiya gathered their soldiers in_order for fighting Israil. Dabid was_told by King Akis, “You(sg) need to know that you(sg) and your(sg) men, will_ indeed _accompany in fighting.”

2 Ne migkahi si Dabid, “Uya, su eyew egkakita nu mismu ke nekey ka egkeyimu ku te suluhuanen nu.”

2 And Dabid said, “Yes, so_that you(sg) yourself can_see what your(sg) servant can_do.”

Ne migkahi si Akis, “Meupiya iya. Eggimuwen kud e sikeykew ne talagbantey ku te ware egtamanan.”

And Akis said, “Good indeed. I will_make you(sg) my guard without ending.”

3 [xr][xr]Te seeye ne timpu, migpatey e si Samwil wey miglungku ka langun ne matig-Israil tenged kandin, wey diye dan sikandin ilebeng te lungsud din diye te Rama. Ne impaawe e ni Saul ka egmahehane wey ka me tumanuren te Israil.

3 [xr][xr]On that day, Samwil had died and all from_Israil had mourned concerning him, and they buried him there in his town of Rama. And Saul had_ the future_tellers and shaman _removed in Israil.

4 Ne miglibulung ka me matig-Pilistiya wey miggendiye te Sunim, wey migkekampu diye, taheed te inlibulung degma ni Saul ka me matig-Israil wey migkekampu diye te Gilbuwa. 5 Te pegkakita ni Saul te me sundalu te matig-Pilistiya, naaldek e sikandin wey amana neenat-henat se kumeng. 6 [xr]Sikan naa ka mig-inse sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama ke nekey ka eggimuwen din. Piru ware sikandin tabaka te Magbebaye minsan pinaahi naan de te taheinep, te Urim,[fn] wey te me prupita. 7 Ne ingkahiyan ni Saul ka me suluhuanen din, “Pamitawi a nikaniyu te malitan ne egpahehane eyew eggendiyaan ku wey egkeinsaan.”

4 And the (ones) from_Pilistiya gathered and went_there to Sunim, and camped there, while Saul gathered the (ones) from_Israil and camped there at Gilbuwa. 5 When Saul saw the soldiers of the (ones) from_Pilistiya, he was afraid and his chest greatly heaved. 6 [xr]So then he asked the Lord God what he should_do. But he wasn't answered by the Lord even just by_means of a dream, Urim,[fn] and of prophets. 7 And Saul told his servants, “Find(pl) for me a woman who predicts_the_future so_that I can_go_there and ask_there.”

Ne migtabak ka me suluhuanen din, “Due diye te Indur.”

And his servants answered, “There_is (one) there at Indur.”

8 Ne migsaluub si Saul te lein ne kumbale eyew ware egpekeila kandin. Te pegkamarusilem e, miggendiyad e si Saul te malitan duma te daruwa te me suluhuanen din. Te pegginguma ran diye, migkahiyan e ni Saul ka malitan, “Ipapitew nu keddi ke nekey ka egginguma pinaahi te peg-inse te sabeka ne gimukud. Umawa nu ka gimukud te minsan hentew ne egngaranan ku.”

8 And Saul dressed in different clothing so_that no (one) would_recognize him. When it was dark, Saul went there to the woman along_with his of two servants. On their arrival there, the woman was_told by Saul, “Show(sg) me what_will_come by_means of one soul. Call(sg) the soul of whoever I name.”

9 Piru migkahiyan sikandin te malitan, “Nakataha ke buwa ma ke nekey ka inggimu ni Saul? Impaawe din ka langun ne egmahehane wey me tumanuren kayi te Israil. Mania te egsahiluten a nikeykew wey eggimatayan?”

9 But he was_told by the woman, “Maybe you(sg) know what_ Saul _has_done? He removed all the future_tellers and shamans here in Israil. Why am I being enticed by you(pl) and killed?”

10 Ne migpahunlibet si Saul kandin pinaahi te manekal ne Magbebaye ne kene din sikandin egmenuwen te peggimu kayi.

10 Saul swore by_means of the strong/living Lord that she wouldn't have_anything_happen for doing this.

11 Ne nataman, mig-inse e ka malitan, “Hentew gimukud te igkeupii nu ne eg-umawen ku?”

11 And then, the woman asked, “Which (LIT Who) soul do you(sg) want me to call?”

Ne migtabak si Saul, “Umawa nu ka gimukud ni Samwil.”

Saul answered, “Call(sg) the soul of Samwil.”

12 Te pegkakita te malitan ki Samwil, migpanguleyi e sikandin ne migkahi, “Mania te in-akalan a nikeykew? Sikeykew bes si Saul!”

12 When the woman saw Samwil, she shouted saying, “Why was I betrayed by_you(sg)? You(sg) [surprise] are Saul!”

13 Ne migkahiyan sikandin ni Saul, “Kene ka kaaldek. Nekey-a ka nakita nu?”

13 She was_told by Saul, “Don't(sg) be_afraid. What did you(sg) see?”

Ne migtabak ka malitan, “Nakakita a te sabeka ne gimukud ne migparibabew puun te tane.”

The woman answered, “I saw one soul rising from the ground.”

14 Ne mig-inse si Saul, “Mamenua sikandin?”

14 Saul asked, “What's his appearance_like?”

Ne migtabak ka malitan, “Buyag ne lukes ne migkukumbale te malayat.”

The woman answered, “An old man wearing (something) long.”

Ne nanengnengan ni Saul ne si Samwil seeye. Ne dutu, miglangkeb e sikandin isip pegtahud kandin.

And Saul knew that that was Samwil. And then, he lay_face_down as (a way of) respecting him.

15 Ne mig-insaan ni Samwil si Saul, “Mania te imbanggew a nikeykew pinaahi te peg-umew nu keddi?”

15 And Saul was_asked by Samwil, “Why have I been_disturbed by_you(sg) by_means of your(sg) calling me?”

Ne migtabak si Saul, “Due dakel ne igkalaggew ku. Migpakig-ehet keddi ka me matig-Pilistiya wey in-engkeran ad e te Manama. Wara ad nikandin tabaka minsan pinaahi te me prupita wey me taheinep. Sikan naa ka impeumew ku sikeykew su eyew egkanangenan a nikeykew ke nekey ka eggimuwen ku.”

Saul answered, “I have a great sadness. The (ones) from_Pilistiya have attacked me and I've been_deserted by God. I haven't been_answered by_him even by_means of prophets and dreams. So then I had_ you(sg) _called so_that I could be informed by_you(sg) what_ I _should do.”

16 Ne migkahi si Samwil, “Mania te eg-inse ka keddi te in-engkeran kad ma te Magbebaye wey neyimu e sikandin ne kuntere nu? 17 [xr]Inggimu e keykew te Magbebaye ne Manama ka ingkahi rin keddi ne eg-aween din ka migharian nu iling te eggisien ne kumbale wey igbehey rin e seini diye te sabeka te me sumbaley nu ne iyan si Dabid. 18 [xr]Inggimu seini te Magbebaye tenged su ware nu tumana ka suhu din ne egguleen nu egpangimatayi ka me Amalikanen wey ka me mananap dan. 19 Seini pad man-e, igpareeg ka te Magbebaye wey ka me matig-Israil te me matig-Pilistiya. Ne kaaselem, sikeykew wey ka me anak nu ne me lukes, eglemung e keddi. Ne igbehey e degma te Magbebaye ka langun ne sundalu te Israil diye te me matig-Pilistiya.”

16 And Samwil said, “Why do you(sg) ask me when you(sg) have deserted by the Lord and he's become your(sg) enemy? 17 [xr]The Lord God has done to you(sg) what_ he _said to_me that he would remove your(sg) kinging like of tearing clothing and he would give it to the one of your(sg) neighbors who is Dabid. 18 [xr]The Lord is doing this because you(sg) didn't obey his command that you(sg) exterminate by killing the Amalikanons and their animals. 19 This also, the Lord will_cause_ you(sg) and the people of Israil _to_be_defeated by the (ones) from_Pilistiya. And tomorrow, you(sg) and your(sg) male children, will_move_in_with me. And the Lord will_ also _give all the soldiers of Israil to the (ones) from_Pilistiya.”

20 Ne sahuhune ne napeled si Saul wey naketeng de diye te tane su naaldek-haldek sikandin te ingkahi ni Samwil. Warad e keseg din su ware ma sikandin migkeen te intiru ne aldew wey marusilem. 21 Ne migparani ka malitan ki Saul wey te pegkakita rin ne amana ka kaaldek ni Saul, migkahiyan din e sikandin, “Mahal ne Hari, inggimu kud ka inhangyu nu keddi minsan nakanengneng a ne nakatahu te karereetan ka umul ku. 22 Sikan naa, pammineha nu ubag seini se iglalag ku degma te suluhuanen nu. Egbehayan ku sikeykew te pegkeen eyew due keseg nu te eggipanew.”

20 And suddenly Saul fell_over and stretched_out onto the ground because he was very_afraid of what_ Samwil _had_said. He had no more strength because he hadn't eaten the entire day and night. 21 The woman approached Saul and on her seeing the great fear of Saul, she said to him, “Honored king, I've done what you(sg) requested of me even though I knew that my life was caught in destruction. 22 So then, please listen(sg) also to what_ your(sg) servant _has_to_say. I will_give you(sg) food so_that you(sg) have strength to walk.”

23 Piru migbalibad sikandin wey migkahi, “Kena a egkeen.” Piru impepehes sikandin pakeena te me suluhuanen din wey te malitan, purisu migpalintutuu e sikandin. Ne mig-enew e sikandin wey migpinnuu e diye te hibatanan. 24 Te seeye ne timpu, due impalambeg te malitan ne nati te baka diye te baley rin.[fn] Ne sahuhune din gilanga seeye wey migkuwa sikandin te harina, wey inluyang din seini. Ne miggilutu e sikandin te paan ne ware patulin. 25 Ne insendad din seini ki Saul wey te me suluhuanen din, wey nangeen e sikandan. Ne nangipanew e sikandan te seeye ne karusileman.

23 But he disagreed and said, “I won't eat.” But he was persuaded to eat by his servants and the woman, therefore he believed. And he arose and sat on the bed. 24 At that time, there_was a cow calf that the woman was fattening at her house.[fn] And she immediately slaughtered it and she got flour, and slurried it. And she cooked bread without rising_agent. 25 And she served this to Saul and to his servants, and they ate(pl). And they went that night.

Ka pegsamsamili ki Dabid te me matig-Pilistiya

The rejection of Dabid by the (ones) from_Pilistiya

291 Ne inlibulung te me matig-Pilistiya diye te Apik ka langun ne sundalu ran diye, wey diye migkekampu ka me matig-Israil te sebseb ne diye te Hisriil. 2 Taheed te miggipanew e ka me pangulu te me sundalu te matig-Pilistiya duma te tigmahatus (100) wey tigsenge-libu (1,000) ne punduk te me sundalu, migsinundul e degma kandan si Dabid wey ka me etew rin duma ki Hari Akis. 3 Ne mig-inse ka me pangulu te me matig-Pilistiya ki Akis, “Mani bes te due me Hibruwanen kayi?”

291 And the (ones) from_Pilistiya gathered all their soldiers at Apik, and the (ones) from_Israil camped at the spring at Hisriil. 2 While the leaders of the (ones) from_Pilistiya went along_with hundreds (100) and thousands (1,000) groups of soldiers, Dabid and his people followed them also along_with King Akis. 3 And the leaders of the (ones) from_Pilistiya asked Akis, “How_come [surprise] there's Hibruwanons here?”

Ne migtabak si Akis, “Si Dabid sika, ka upisyal te Hari te Israil ne si Saul. Suble e te sabeka ne leg-un ka pegduruma ku kandin. Bunsud pad te peg-awe din ki Saul taman kuntee, ware de due nakita ku ne seyyup ne neyimu rin.”

And Akis answered, “That's Dabid, the official of the Saul the king of Israil. He's been with me over one year. Beginning from his leaving Saul until now, I simply haven't seen any mistake that he's made.”

4 Piru nabelu ki Akis ka me pangulu te me matig-Pilistiya wey migkahi, “Palibera nu sika ne etew diye te inged ne imbehey nu kandin. Keilangan ne kene sikandin egpakaruma kanta te egpakiggira su kema ke egkuntereen ki nikandin ke diyad e te eggiraan. Su warad lein ne meupiya ne paahi eyew egpekeg-uli sikandan te ahalen din du te peggimatey te me etew ta. 5 [xr]Sikan ma mule ka Dabid ne in-ulahingan te me malitan taheed te egsesayew sikandan ne miggenendue,

4 But the leaders of the (ones) from_Pilistiya were angry at Akis and said, “Send_back(sg) that person to the place you(sg) gave him. It's_necessary that he doesn't accompany us(incl) in fighting because what if we(incl) become_enemies of_his there in the fighting_place. Because there's_no better way in_order for him and his master to_be_reconciled than in killing our(incl) people. 5 [xr]That's the Dabid on_the_contrary that they sing_about while they dance going,

‘Eglibu-libu ka neyimatayan ni Saul,

‘Saul killed thousands,

piru egsapulu ne libu mule ka neyimatayan ni Dabid.’ ”

but Dabid on_the_contrary killed tens of thousands.’ ”

6 Purisu in-umew ni Akis si Dabid wey migkahiyan, “Egpahunlibet a te manekal ne Magbebaye ne Manama te egkasalihan ka iya wey igkeupii ku perem ne egduma ka keddi te egpakiggira. Su bunsud te timpu ne miggendiye ka keddi taman kuntee, ware nakita ku ne seyyup ne neyimu nu. Piru ware migsuhut ka duma ne me pangulu ne egduma ka. 7 Purisu uli kad e mule ne kene kema kabantali. Kene ka himu te minsan nekey ne igkeepes dan.”

6 Therefore Akis called Dabid and said (to him), “I swear by the strong/living Lord God that you(sg) are trustworthy and I wanted you(sg) to accompany me in warring. Because from the time that you(sg) went to me until now, I haven't seen (any) mistake that you(sg) have done. But the other leaders didn't agree that you(sg) accompany. 7 Therefore return_home(sg) Go(sg) and don't be worried. Don't(sg) do anything that_ they _don't_like.”

8 Piru mig-inse si Dabid, “Mahal ne Hari, nekey-a ka neyimu ku wey nekey bes ka nakita nu kayi te keddi te suluhuanen nu bunsud te timpu ne migginguma a diye te keykew? Mania te kena a egpakaruma keykew te egpakiggira te me kuntere nu?”

8 But Dabid asked, “Honored king, what have I done and what [surprise] have you(sg) seen in me your(sg) servant from the time that I arrived there at your(sg) (place)? Why can't I accompany you(sg) to fight your(sg) enemies?”

9 Ne migtabak si Akis, “Nakataha a ne ware igkarew-ey keykew iling te panalihan te Manama. Piru migkahi ka me pangulu te me matig-Pilistiya, ‘Keilangan ne kene sikandin egpakaruma diye te bunuanan.’ 10 Purisu selem-selem ka enew kaselem wey uli kad duma te me etew nu ke egkaliwaswas e.”

9 Akis answered, “I know that there's_nothing to_scold_ you(sg) _for like an angel of God. But the leaders of the (ones) from_Pilistiya said, ‘It's_necessary that he doesn't accompany (us) to the fighting_place.’ 10 Therefore rise early tomorrow and return_home(sg) along_with your(sg) people when it's first_light.”

11 Purisu migselem-selem mig-enew si Dabid wey ka me etew rin, wey miglibed e sikandan diye te tane te me matig-Pilistiya. Piru migpabulus mule ka me matig-Pilistiya diye te Hisriil.

11 Therefore Dabid and his people rose early, and they returned to the land of the (ones) from_Pilistiya. But the (ones) from_Pilistiya on_the_contrary continued to Hisriil.

Ka peggule ni Dabid te me Amalikanen

The extermination of the Amalikanons by Dabid

301 Peglihad te tatelu ne aldew, miggingume e si Dabid wey ka me etew rin diye te Siklag wey nanengnengan dan ne inlusuran bes te me Amalikanen ka inged te Nigib wey ka Siklag. Ne natalu ran ka me matig-Siklag wey insilaban dan ka lungsud dan. 2 Ne impandakep dan ka me malitan wey ka tagse sabeka diye, buyag ma wey se bate piru ware minsan sabeka ne innimatayan dan. 3 Te pegginguma ni Dabid duma te me etew rin, nakita ran ne nasilaban e ka inged dan wey impandakep e ka me asawa ran wey me anak dan ne me lukes wey me malitan. 4 Purisu migpataman-taman sikandan migpandalawit taman te warad keseg dan. 5 [xr]Ne impandakep degma ka daruwa ne duwey ni Dabid ne si Ahinuwam ne matig-Hisriil wey si Abigil ne balu ni Nabal ne matig-Karmil.

301 After three days had past, Dabid and his people arrived there at Siklag and they knew that Amalikanons had invaded in the place of Nigib and Siklag. They defeated the (ones) from_Siklag and they burned their city. 2 They had captured the women and every (one) there, old and young but they hadn't killed even one. 3 When Dabid together his people arrived, they saw that their place had_been_burned and their spouses and their male and female children had been_captured. 4 Therefore they wailed intensely until they had no more strength. 5 [xr]The two junior_wives of Dabid Ahinuwam from Hisriil and Abigil the widow of Nabal from_Karmil had also been_captured.

6 Ne amana nalaggew si Dabid tenged su migmalalahey ka me etew ne egbebatuwen sikandin tenged te kalaggew ran te pegkarakep te me kabatbataan. Piru inlig-en si Dabid te Magbebaye ne Manama rin. 7 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan ni Dabid ka talagpanubad ne si Abiyatar ne anak ni Ahimilik, “Ne kun la, uyana nu kayi ka ipud.” Sikan naa ka in-uyan e ni Abiyatar seini diye ki Dabid. 8 Ne mig-inse e si Dabid te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Eglupuhen ney naa ka me etew ne miglusud kanami? Egkalupug ney naa sikandan?”

6 Dabid was very sad because the people spoke_with_each_other that he should be stoned due to their sadness about the capturing of the children. But Dabid was strengthened by the Lord his God. 7 [xr]And Dabid said to the sacrificer Abiyatar the child of Ahimilik, “Please, bring(sg) the ephod here (to me).” So then Abiyatar brought it to Dabid. 8 And Dabid asked the Lord God, “Shall we(excl) pursue the people who invaded us(excl)? Can they be reached_in_pursuit by us(excl)?”

Ne migtabak ka Magbebaye, “Uya, lupuha niyu sikandan su egkeumaan niyu iya sikandan wey egkaluwas ka naddakep.”

And the Lord answered, “Yes, pursue(pl) them because they'll be indeed reached by you(pl) and the (ones) captured will_be_saved.”

9 Purisu inlupug e sikandan ni Dabid duma te hen-em ne gatus (600) ne me etew taman te nekeuma sikandan diye te bangalug te Bisur. Te pegginguma ran diye, migpalunggehaat de dutu 10 ka daruwa ne gatus (200) ne etew tenged su nabeley-beley e sikandan wey kenad egpakalapas te bangalug. Piru migpabulus mule miglupug si Dabid wey ka hep-at ne gatus (400) ne me etew. 11 Ne due matig-Ihiptu ne nakita te me etew ni Dabid diye te kamet wey in-uuyan dan e sikandin diye ki Dabid. Imbehayan dan sikandin te weyig wey te egkakeen 12 ne inggimu puun te behas te iggira wey daruwa ne timman ne egkakeen ne hinimu puun te behas te paras tenged su warad iya sikandin nakakeen wey nekeinum te tatelu ne aldew wey marusilem. Te nekeimpus e sikandin ka egkeen, migmanekal e sikandin. 13 Ne mig-insaan sikandin ni Dabid, “Hentew-a ka ahalen nu wey hendei ka ne mahinged?”

9 Therefore Dabid with six hundred (600) people pursued them until they reached at the brook of Bisur. When they reached this, just remained there 10 two hundred (200) people because they couldn't cross the valley because they were_ very _tired. But Dabid and the four hundred (400) people continued on_the_contrary in chasing. 11 And the people of Dabid saw (a person) from_Ihiptu in a field and they brought him to Dabid. They gave him water and food 12 made from the fruit of figs and two pieces of food made from fruit of grapevines because he hadn't eaten or drunk for three days and nights. When he had_finished eating, he strengthened. 13 Dabid asked him, “Who is your(sg) master and where are you(sg) a_local_of?”

Ne migtabak sikandin, “Sabeka a ne Ihiptuhanen wey suluhuanen te Amalikanen. Tatelu e ne aldew ka miglihad te mig-engkeran a te ahalen ku tenged su migderalu a.14 Inlusuran ney ka inged te Nigib ne sakup te Huda ne in-ugpaan te me Kiritihanen, wey ka inged ne in-ugpaan te kabuhalan ni Kalib. Ne insilaban ney ka Siklag.”

And he answered, “I'm an Egyptian and a servant of an Amalikanon. Three days have passed (since) I was left_behind by my master because I was sick.14 We(excl) invaded the land of Nigib under_the_jurisdiction of Huda that residence of Kiritihanons, and the land that residence of descendants of Kalib. And we(excl) burned Siklag.”

15 Ne mig-insaan e man-e sikandin ni Dabid, “Egkaayun naa ne egdumaan key nikeykew diye te ingkekampuwan dan?”

15 And he was_asked by Dabid again, “Can you(sg) take us(excl) there to their camping_place?”

Ne migtabak sikandin, “Pahunlibet ke pa keddi pinaahi te Manama ne kena a nikeykew eggimatayan wey ke igbehey naa diye te ahalen ku, ne egkataman, egdumaan kud e sikaniyu diye te kandan.”16 Sikan naa, indumaan din e ensi Dabid diye te ingkekampuwan te migpanlusud ne me Amalikanen.

And he answered, “Swear(sg) to_me by_means of God that I won't be_killed by_you(sg) or given to my master, and then, I will_take you(pl) to them.”16 So then, he took Dabid and_company to the camping_place of the invaders who were Amalikanons.

Ne diye, neumaan dan sikandan ne migtalagtag ne migmangekeen, migmangiinum, wey miggale-gale tenged su masalig ka naahew ran puun te me matig-Pilistiya wey puun diye te Huda.17 Te pegkaliwaswas, migbunsud e migpabunbunuey ensi Dabid taman te marusilem. Ne ware minsan sabeka te Amalikanen ne nakapallahuy angin e te seeye se hep-at ne gatus (400) ne lukes-lukes ne migmanguntud te me kamil. 18 Ne naawi ded ni Dabid ka langun ne naahew te me Amalikanen, lagkes ka daruwa ne duwey rin. 19 Warad iya sikandan nasalini minsan sabeka, bate ma wey ke buyag, lukes ma wey ke malitan, wey te minsan nekey ne naahew te me Amalikanen. 20 Naawi ded degma ni Dabid ka langun ne karniru wey me baka. Ne in-alew pewun-a te me etew ni Dabid ka me ayam wey migkahi sikandan, “Unag seini ki Dabid.”

And there, they reached them who were spread_out eating(pl), drinking, and having_fun because they had snatched lots from the (ones) from_Pilistiya and from Huda.17 At dawn, Dabid and_company began fighting until darkness. And not even one of the Amalikanons was_able to flee except those four hundred (400) young_men that mounted(pl) camels. 18 And Dabid recovered all that had been_snatched by the Amalikanons, including his two junior_wives. 19 There_is_not indeed even one lost among them, child or elderly, male or female, or anything snatched by the Amalikanons. 20 Dabid also recovered all the sheep and cattle. And the people of Dabid herded_up the domestic_animals and they said, “This is Dabid's prize.”

21 Te nekeume e ensi Dabid diye bangalug te Bisur, insinug-ung e sikandan te seeye se daruwa ne gatus (200) ne etew rin ne migpalunggehaat de tenged su nabeley-beley e sikandan, wey in-elit-elit sikandan enni Dabid. 22 Piru migkahi ka maddeet wey talaggimu te samuk ne me etew ne migduma ki Dabid, “Kene ta sikandan egbaaran te naahew ta te me Amalikanen tenged su ware ma sikandan migduma kanta. Iyan te re igbehey kandan ka me asawa ran wey me anak dan. Ne egpeyipanawen tad sikandan.”

21 When Dabid and_company arrived at the brook of Bisur, they met the two hundred (200) of his people that just remained because they were tired, and Dabid and_company greeted them. 22 But the evil people and makers of trouble who had accompanied Dabid said, “We(incl) won't divide_up what_ we(incl) _snatched from the Amalikanons because they didn't accompany us(incl). We(incl) will_ just _give them their spouses and their children. And we(incl) send_ them _on.”

23 Ne migkahi si Dabid, “Me suled, kene niyu sika himuwa su imbehey sika te Magbebaye kanta. Impangabangan ki nikandin wey impepanalu te migpanlusud kanta. 24 Ware iya eg-uyun te sika se ingkahi niyu. Ka baad te seeye se migpalunggehaat ne migbantey te me kasangkapan ta, iling ded te baad te seeye se migduma diye te bunuanan. Egpekeg-iling ka baad ne igbehey te langun.” 25 Puun te seeye ne timpu, inggimu e seini ni Dabid ne balaud wey tulumanen para te me matig-Israil taman kuntee.

23 And Dabid said, “Brothers, don't(pl) do that because that was_given to_us(incl) by the Lord. We(incl) were_helped by_him and made_victorious over (those who) invaded us(incl). 24 None indeed will_agree of that you(pl) said. The portion of those who remained that guarded our(incl) equipment, (will be) just like of the portion that of those who accompanied to the fighting_place. The portion that will_be_given for all will_be_the_same.” 25 From that time, Dabid made this a law and something_to_obey for the (ones) from_Israil until now.

Ka pegdasag ni Dabid te me alukuy rin

The rewarding by Dabid of his friends

26 Te pegginguma ni Dabid diye te Siklag, impeuyanan din e te baad te naahew ran ka me igdatu diye te Huda ne me alukuy rin duma te seini ne lalag, “Igdasag ku seini kaniyu puun te naahew ney te me kuntere te Magbebaye ne Manama.” 27 Impeuyanan din degma seeye se me etew ne diye te lungsud te Bitil, Ramut-Nigib, Hatir, 28 Aruwir, Sipmut, Istimuwa, 29 Rakal, wey diye te me lungsud te me Hiramilhanen, diye te me lungsud te me Kinihanen, 30 diye te Hurma, diye te Bur-Asan, diye te Atak, 31 diye te Hibrun, wey diye te langun ne inged ne inleleuhan ni Dabid wey te me etew rin.

26 When Dabid arrived at Siklag, he sent a portion of what_ they _had_snatched to his friends the elders of Judah along_with this word, “I give this to_you(pl) from what_ we(excl) _snatched from the enemies of the Lord God.” 27 He also sent those people who were in the towns of Bitil, Ramut-Nigib, Hatir, 28 Aruwir, Sipmut, Istimuwa, 29 Rakal, and to the towns of the Hiramilhanon, and the Kinihanons, 30 to Hurma, to Bur-Asan, to Atak, 31 to Hibrun, and to all the places wandered_to by Dabid and his people.

Ka pegpatey enni Saul wey te me anak din

The death of Saul and his children

(1 Kru 10:1‑12)

(1 Chr 10:1‑12)

311 Ne migpabunbunuey ka me matig-Pilistiya wey ka me matig-Israil diye te Bubungan te Gilbuwa. Ne masalig ka nenamatey te me matig-Israil diye wey nenakapallahuy ka duma kandan. 2 Ne impatamtamanan lupuha te me matig-Pilistiya si Saul wey ka anak din ne me lukes wey neyimatayan dan ka me anak din ne si Diyunatan, Abinadab, wey si Malkisuwa. 3 Ne migmasumpit pad ka gira ne nakalingut ki Saul wey nakita sikandin te me talagpane. Ne dutu, impepane dan e sikandin wey dakel ka pali din. 4 Ne migkahiyan ni Saul ka talag-uyan te panganiban din, “Hulabuta nu ka kampilan nu wey himatayi a nikeykew, su kema ke iyan egpekeyimatey keddi sika se me etew ne ware migpalintutuu te Manama.[fn] Ne puun due, egbalbalayen ad nikandan.” Piru ware seeye himuwa te talag-uyan te panganiban din su naaldek amana sikandin. Sikan naa ka ingkuwe e ni Saul ka kampilan din wey migluhe e sikandin. 5 Te pegkakita te talag-uyan te panganiban te migpatey e si Saul, inggulabut din e degma ka kampilan din wey migluhe e degma sikandin, wey migpatey e sikandin duma ki Saul. 6 Purisu migpatey si Saul wey ka tatelu ne anak din ne me lukes, ka talag-uyan te panganiban din, wey ka langun ne me etew rin te seeye de ne aldew. 7 Te pegkarineg te me matig-Israil ne diye nangugpe te talipag te napu te Hisriil wey talipag te Hurdan te namallahuy e ka me sundalu te Israil wey migpatey e si Saul wey ka me anak din, in-engkeran dan e ka me lungsud dan, wey migpamallahuy e degma sikandan. Purisu miggendiyaan e seini te me matig-Pilistiya wey migsubalan dan e ugpei.

311 And the (ones) from_Pilistiya and the (ones) from_Israil fought_each_other on the Mountain of Gilbuwa. And many from_Israil died(pl) there and others of them fled(pl). 2 Saul and his male children were thoroughly pursued by the (ones) from_Pilistiya and they killed his children Diyunatan, Abinadab, and Malkisuwa. 3 The war became_extremely around Saul and he was_seen by the archers. And then, they shot_ him _with_a_bow and his wound was big. 4 Saul said to the carrier of his weapons, “Draw(sg) your(sg) sword and kill(sg) me, because what if those people who don't believe in God[fn] can_kill me. And from that, I will_be_mocked by_them.” But the carrier of his weapons didn't do that because he was very afraid. So then Saul got his sword and he killed_himself. 5 When the carrier of weapons saw that Saul had died, he also drew his sword and he also killed_himself, and he died along_with Saul. 6 Therefore Saul and his three male children, the carrier of his weapons, and all his people died on that same day. 7 When the (ones) from_Israil who lived on the opposite side of the valley of Hisriil and the opposite_site of the Hurdan heard that the soldiers of Israil had fled and Saul and his children had died, they left their towns, and they also fled. Therefore the (ones) from_Pilistiya went there and they substituted living there.

8 Te seup ne aldew, miggendiye ka me matig-Pilistiya te Bubungan te Gilbuwa eyew te pegpanguwa te me kasangkapan te nenamatey. Ne nakita ran diye si Saul wey ka tatelu ne anak din ne me lukes ne nenamatey diye. 9 Ne intempug dan e ka ulu ni Saul wey ingkuwa ran e ka me kasangkapan din te egpakiggira. Ne migsuhu sikandan te me etew peendiye te intiru ne tane te me matig-Pilistiya eyew te pegpanengneng te meupiya ne panugtulen diye te timplu te me diyus-diyus dan wey diye te me etew. 10 Ne intahu dan ka panganiban wey ka kasangkapan ni Saul te egpakiggira diye te timplu te diyus-diyus dan ne si Astarut wey impagket dan ka lawa rin diye te matikang wey makepal ne alad ne batu te siyudad te Bit-San.

8 The next day, the (ones) from_Pilistiya went to the Mountain of Gilbuwa in_order for getting(pl) the equipment of the dead(pl). They saw Saul and his three male children that had died there. 9 And they cut_off the head of Saul and they took his equipment in fighting. And they commanded people in the entire land of Pilistihanons in_order to_have_ the temple of their false_gods and the people _informed of the good news. 10 They put the weapons and warring equipment of Saul in the temple of their false_god Astarut and they fastened his body on the high and thick stone fence of city of Bit-San.

11 Te pegkarineg te me etew te Habis-Gilyad te inggimu te me matig-Pilistiya ki Saul, 12 miggipanew e ka langun ne bahani te intiru ne marusilem peendiye te Bit-San. Ne ingkuwa ran e ka lawa ni Saul wey ka lawa te me anak din diye te alabat te Bit-San wey in-uyan dan e seini diye te Habis, wey insilaban dan e. 13 Ne ingkuwa ran e ka me tul-an dan wey inlebeng dan e diye te lebut te kayu ne tamarisku diye te Habis. Ne ware sikandan migkeen te pitu ne aldew.

11 When those people of Habis-Gilyad heard what_ the (ones) from_Pilistiya _had_done to Saul, 12 all the heroes/warriors traveled for the entire night going to Bit-San. And they took the body of Saul and the bodies of his children from the wall of Bit-San and they brought these to Habis, and they burned_them. 13 And they took their bones and they buried_them in the base of a tamarisku tree there at Habis. And they didn't eat for seven days.
